moves.description: You disappear from view and prepare to surprise a target with an attack. When you activate this move, you become invisible and immune to any attacks of opportunity. You cannot be targeted by attacks while you are invisible. On your next turn, you use may your action to reappear at a point within range and make a melee attack against a creature, with advantage, dealing 4d12 + MOVE ghost damage on a successful hit. Protect and Detect reactions may not be used when hit by this attack.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Shadow Punch
moves.description: You throw a punch from the surrounding shadows, unavoidable by any creature. This move is guaranteed to hit for 2d8 + MOVE ghost damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Shadow Sneak
moves.description: You extend your shadow to strike a creature from behind. As a bonus action, you can control your shadow to make a ranged attack roll against a target within range dealing 1d6 ghost damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Silent Approach
moves.description: A ghostly darkness envelops you, hiding you, masking your scent and dampening the noise you make. For the duration, gain advantage on stealth checks. Other creatures have disadvantage when attempting to locate you with a perception check using sight, smell or hearing.

moves.name: Soul Drain
moves.description: The user attempts to drain the life force of a creature within 30 feet. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it takes 3d10 + MOVE ghost damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute. The user regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Spectral Chains
moves.description: The user creates ghostly chains that attempt to bind a target within 60 feet. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the target is restrained and cannot teleport or leave its current plane. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

moves.name: Spectral Surge
moves.description: You may use this reaction whenever a creature in range is using a stat boosting move. A strong ghostly current attempts to steal the stat boost effect and give it to you. Make a ranged attack roll, stealing the stat bonus on a hit.

moves.name: Spectral Thief
moves.description: You succumb to darkness and transport yourself into a creature's shadow. Immediately teleport to a point in range and make a melee attack on a creature. On hit, you steal all positive stat changes affecting the creature (increases to AC, attack rolls, damage bonuses, etc.) and deal 3d10 + MOVE ghost damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Spectral Vision
moves.description: You foresee the next move of a creature, allowing you to react immediately. When targeted by a move, or forced to make a saving throw, you may automatically avoid the damage/effects on the first instance of this reaction, and then use a move you know, targeting your attacker. You must pay the VP cost of both this move and the move you choose to activate as a reaction. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful.

moves.name: Spirit Shackle
moves.description: You employ dark energy to stitch a creature’s shadow to the ground. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE ghost damage on a hit. On hit, the target is unable to flee or switch out while the user remains in battle.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: When hit by a targeted attack, you can spend a reaction to attempt to drain the attacker’s VP, if they are in range. Force the attacker to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, the target loses the amount of VP it spent on the move, and you gain an equal amount.

moves.name: Trick-or-Treat
moves.description: You attempt to scare the spirit right out of a creature in range. Force a creature in range to make a CHA save against your Move DC. On a failure, its type is changed to Ghost for the duration.

moves.name: White Bloom

effects.note: reaction at 0 HP; the white bloom replaces you

moves.description: Upon reaching 0 HP in combat, instead of fainting, you may use this reaction if you have enough remaining VP. A snow white flower blooms at your feet, closing around you as your body undergoes metamorphosis. For one minute, you are incapacitated. The white bloom has the grass and ghost types, begins with 2x your current max HP, 0 speed, otherwise it has the same stats as you, including your level. It replaces you on the battlefield and in the initiative order. The white bloom knows the following moves: Power Whip, Defense Curl, Wrap, and Spiky Shield. If the white bloom is destroyed before it opens, it activates the move Self-Destruct, and you disappear forever. After 1 minute, the white bloom opens to reveal your White Bloom form. Regain full HP and VP, gain proficiency with Fairy type moves and learn the move Forest Guardian. If you survive this encounter, you remain in White Bloom form.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.description: You attempt to absorb some of an enemy’s health. Make a melee attack on a Pokémon. On a hit, the Pokémon takes 1d6 + MOVE grass damage. Half the damage done is restored by the user.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Aromatherapy
moves.description: You release a pleasant aroma that empowers your allies. All allies within a ten foot circle, centered on you, are cured of all negative status ailments.

moves.name: Bioluminescent Spores
moves.description: You release glowing spores that shed dim light in a 5-foot radius. The light lasts for 1 hour before dissipating.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: You fire a series of high-speed seeds at an opponent. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d10 grass damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Cactus Bloom
moves.description: When a creature in range falls in battle, you may cause a cactus to grow out of it, draining its remaining life force as it sprouts 1d4 + MOVE cactus fruit. The fallen creature now has one failed death save. The cactus fruit may be picked and consumed to heal 2d4 +2 HP.
moves.scaling: The healing from the cactus fruit is increased to 3d6 + 6 HP at level 10, and 4d12 + 10 HP at level 17.

moves.name: Canopy
moves.description: You sprout a canopy of sap-filled leaves that surround you on all sides. Increase your AC by 1. This increase may be stacked, to a maximum of +5. Attacks against you of a type you are vulnerable to remove any bonus AC you have stacked up with this move on a hit.

moves.name: Constricting Vines
moves.description: Vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on the user. The area becomes difficult terrain, and any creature that enters the area or starts its turn there must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until the end of its next turn.

moves.name: Cotton Guard
moves.description: You protect yourself by wrapping your body up in thick, soft cotton. For the duration, boost your AC by +2.

moves.name: Cotton Spore

effects.note: only if the failed CON save's speed reduction (-10 ft) brings its speed to 0

moves.description: You unleash spores of thick cotton that covers the opponent. Force a target in range to make a CON save against your Move DC. On a fail, the target’s speed is reduced by 10 for the duration. If this reduction in speed causes their speed to be 0, they are restrained for the duration.

moves.name: Disorienting Powder

effects.note: disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws; other creatures have +1 to attack rolls against it

moves.description: You release a cloud of powder that disorients and confuses creatures in a 5ft. radius within range. Any affected creature must succeed a WIS saving throw, or suffer disadvantage on their attack rolls and saving throws, and other creatures have +1 to attack rolls made against the affected creatures until the beginning of your next turn.. On a failure of 5 or more, the creature becomes confused.

moves.name: Energy Ball

effects.note: the next attack against the target

moves.description: You draw in power from nature in a concentrated ball that you send towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the next attack against the target is rolled at advantage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Forest's Curse
moves.description: You summon the energy of the forest to change the type of another creature. Force a creature in range to make a CON save against your Move DC. On a failure, its type is changed to Grass for the duration.

moves.name: Frenzy Plant
moves.description: You summon a whirlwind of jagged branches and razor sharp leaves that batter all creatures in a 10 foot radius, centered on you. All creatures caught in the area must make a DEX saving throw against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE grass damage on a failure, and half as much on a success. This move saps you of energy, and may not make any attack until after the end of your next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: You attempt to drain the life force of a target. Make a ranged attack on a target, doing 2d8 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. Half of the damage dealt is restored to the user.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: You attempt to ensnare a creature with vines that sprout from the ground, causing it to trip. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. If the targets size is Large or bigger, double the dice roll for the damage. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target falls prone.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Grass Pledge
moves.description: You send a column of thick grass towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. After you land a hit, any ally that uses another Pledge move in the same round automatically hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Grass Whistle
moves.description: You make a shrill sound that has the chance to put a creature to sleep. The target must make a WIS save against your Move DC, falling asleep on a failure.

moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.description: Grass sprouts from the ground in a circle around you, coating the earth with healing energy. For 3 turns, all creatures in the affected area heal for 2d8 hit points at the end of their turn. In addition, creatures may double their MOVE modifier on damage rolls from grass-type moves activated inside the area.
moves.scaling: The healiinig dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Horn Leech
moves.description: You sink your horns into a creature, draining some of their power. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. Half the damage dealt is recovered by the user (rounded down).
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.description: You pierce the ground with roots, absorbing natural energy and fixing you in place. At the end of each of your next three turns (including this one), heal yourself for 1d10 + MOVE hit points as a free action. During this time, you may not move or be switched out.
moves.scaling: The healing dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

effects.note: Also covers this move's own "cannot be switched out" -- trapped already means exactly that. Movement is enforced server-side (_move_token); switching isn't, since the shared system has no switch-Pokemon mechanic of its own yet.

moves.name: Leaf Blade
moves.description: You attempt to slash a creature with a sharp leaf. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing 2d8 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. This attack scores a critical on 19 and 20.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: You whip up a powerful storm of leaves in a 10 foot radius, centered on a point within range. All creatures in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE grass damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. After activating this move, you are sapped of energy. Your next attack deals half the normal damage, if it hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Leaf Tornado

effects.note: its next attack
if it activates a move that requires a saving throw, its targets have advantage

moves.description: You summon forth a cyclone of harsh winds and fast moving leaves that rushes forward to strike a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 3d10 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 15 or higher, the target has disadvantage on its next attack. If the target activates a move that requires a saving throw, its target(s) have advantage on the roll.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Leafage
moves.description: You summon a flurry of leaves to pelt a target. Make a ranged attack, doing 1d6 + MOVE grass damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17

moves.name: Leech Seed

ends.text: until it faints or is switched out

effects.note: 1d4 grass damage at the end of each of its turns; half is restored to the attacker

moves.description: You send a seed at a creature in range that implants itself in their hide. Make a ranged attack roll. On a hit, a seed implants into their skin. The target takes 1d4 grass damage at the end of each of its subsequent turns until it faints or is switched out. Half of the damage is restored by the attacker, or any other active creature the trainer has in battle, even if the original attacker faints or is returned to its Pokéball. Only one creature can be seeded by the attacker at a time.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d4 at level 5, 2d6 at level 10, and 2d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: You summon a sharp, magical leaf that strikes a creature. This move is guaranteed to hit for 1d10 + MOVE grass damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.description: You attempt to drain the life force of a target. Make a ranged attack on a target, doing 1d10 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. Half of the damage dealt is restored to the user.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Mycological Network
moves.description: You connect to fungal networks in the soil to sense basic information about the surrounding ecosystem within 30 feet, including the health of plants and the presence of decay. This move can be used once per hour.

moves.name: Nature's Embrace
moves.description: You call upon the power of nature to protect you. Whenever you sustain damage of a type you are vulnerable to, you may use this reaction to discount the extra damage. Make a ranged attack roll, redirecting the damage you avoided to a creature in range on a hit.

moves.name: Needle Arm
moves.description: Your arms turn iinto jagged, thorny needles as you strike a creature. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is a 15 or more, the target flinches.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Petal Blizzard
moves.description: You stir up a blizzard of sharp petals that swirl around you. Any creature in a 15ft radius, centered on you, must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE grass damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Petal Dance

effects.note: only if you use the move again the following turn; at the end of that turn

moves.description: You dance around, releasing a flurry of sharp leaf attacks against a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 2d8 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. On the following turn, you may choose to use this action again to hit automatically, but if you do, you become confused at the end of your turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.description: You violently whirl your tentacles or vines towards a target. Make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing 2d8 + MOVE grass damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.description: You send a razor sharp leaf at a creature in range at tremendous speed. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. Razor Leaf results in a critical hit on 19s and 20s.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Release Spores
moves.description: You release decomposing spores in a 5-foot radius. Each non-decomposer creature in the area must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 poison damage and be poisoned until the end of their next turn. This move can be used once per day.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: You fire a series of hard seeds that crash down on top of a creature in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE grass damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Seed Flare
moves.description: You release a bright shockwave from your body, damaging all creatures within 20 feet of you. Any creature in range must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE grass damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Until the end of your next turn, any attack roll made against a target that failed its save is rolled at advantage. This move can be used once per short rest.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description: You release a cluster of spores at a creature in range, attempting to put them to sleep. The target must make a CON saving throw against your Move DC or fall asleep.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: When you use this move, soak in solar energy and prepare to unleash a devastating beam. On your next turn, if you keep your concentration, use an action to create a 80 foot line of solar energy, 5 feet wide. All creatures caught in the line must succeed on a DEX save or take 3d10 + MOVE grass damage on a fail and half as much on a save. If this move is used in harsh sunlight, double your MOVE modifier for damage and it can be used on the turn it is activated, without concentration.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Solar Blade
moves.description: When you activate this move, you use your action gathering in solar energy to prepare to strike with blades. On your next turn, if you keep your concentration. use an action to make a melee attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. If this move is used in harsh sunlight, double your MOVE modifier for damage and it can be used on the turn it is activated.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Soothing Breeze
moves.description: You summon a healing breeze in a 30ft. radius from a point within range, that restores 3d10 + MOVE hit points to all friendly creatures. This move can be used once per long rest.
moves.scaling: The healing dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Spiky Shield
moves.description: You quickly raise a spiked shield to protect yourself from damage. When you are hit by a melee attack, use your reaction to ignore damage, dealing grass damage equal to your proficiency modifier to the attacker instead. On future instances of this reaction in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful. Unless the successful roll is 20, the damage you take instead drains your VP for half the damage amount.

moves.name: Spore
moves.description: When you are targeted by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to release a spore that attempts to put your attacker to sleep. The creature must make a CON save against your Move DC, falling asleep on a fail.

moves.name: Spore Cloud
moves.description: You emit a cloud of glowing spores in a 40ft. radius around you. All creatures that are not Grass type in the cloud must make a Constitution saving throw, or suffer one of the following effects, chosen by you: Asleep, confused, paralyzed, poisoned. You may choose one effect per use of this move. For three rounds, the cloud lingers before dissipating. After succeeding the initial saving throw, all creatures ending their turn inside the cloud must make the saving throw again.
moves.scaling: At level 10, add +2 to the DC of this move. At level 15, add +5.

moves.name: Spud Bomb
moves.description: You hurl a barrage of hard spuds at a creature in range. Roll a ranged attack, dealing 4d12 MOVE grass damage on a hit. The creature hit must then make a CON save against your move DC, taking an equal amount of MOVE fire damage on a failure.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Strength Sap
moves.description: If a creature attempts to use a move that boosts its stats, you may use your reaction to negate the increase and convert it into healing energy, recovering 1d10 + MOVE hit points. This includes critical hit bonuses, AC increases, speed, attack and damage boosts, etc.
moves.scaling: The healing dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description: When you are subject to a melee attack, you can use your reaction to release a spore that attempts to stun your attacker. The creature must make a CON save against your Move DC, becoming paralyzed on a fail.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: You regenerate from the inside, healing some of your wounds. Heal yourself for 2d8 + MOVE hit points.
moves.scaling: The healing dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Tera Drain
moves.description: Roots erupt from the ground in a 20ft radius centered on a point within 60ft. All creatures must make a CON save, taking 4d12 + MOVE grass damage on fail, half on success. You heal for 50% of total damage dealt to all targets.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Trop Kick

effects.note: for the remainder of combat

moves.description: You attempt to land an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. Make a melee attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. On a natural role of 16 or more, the target adds -1 to any attack it makes for the remainder of combat. This modifier can be stacked up to a maximum of -5.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.description: You extend a sharp vine to whip the target with. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d6 + MOVE grass damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description: You slam your rough body against a creature, taking serious recoil damage. Make an attack roll against a target, dealing 2d10 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. On a hit, you also take a quarter of the damage dealt in typeless recoil damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d10 at level 5, 4d10 at level 10, and 6d10 at level 17.

moves.name: Worry Seed

effects.note: replaces the user's choice of ability; prevents sleep; on humans, no long-rest benefits and eventually exhaustion

moves.description: You shoot a bizarre seed that implants worry into another creature. The target must succeed on a CON save against your Move DC or replace the user's choice of ability with Insomnia, preventing sleep for the duration. If successfully used on a human, it will not be able to gain benefits from long resting for the duration, and will eventually provoke exhaustion.

moves.name: Bone Club
moves.description: You strike a Pokémon with a club of bone, doing 1d10 + MOVE ground damage on a successful hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target flinches.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Bone Rush
moves.description: You rush forward to deliver a series of hard hits against a Pokémon. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d6 + MOVE ground damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 ground damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Bonemerang
moves.description: You throw a boomerang and make two ranged attacks against a target. On each successful hit, do 1d10 + MOVE ground damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: You strike the ground so hard that it ripples outcfrom you in a 15 foot radius. All grounded creatures caught in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE ground damage on a failure.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Devastating Tremors

effects.note: DC 20 CON save the user makes after using the move

moves.description: You slam into the ground with immense force, creating tremors that break the ground in a 100ft. radius centered on you. All grounded creatures within the affected area must succeed a STR saving throw or take 10d12 + MOVE ground damage and are knocked prone. On a success, they take half damage and are not knocked prone. After doing this move, you must succeed a DC 20 CON saving throw, or become incapacitated for 1 round while recovering. The ground becomes difficult rocky terrain, and in a 15ft. radius centered on you, the ground becomes hazardous difficult terrain, dealing 2d6 typeless damage to creatures attempting to move through it. This move can be used once per long rest.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: Your Pokémon burrows underground, disappearing from view before striking from underneath a foe. When you activate this move, you burrow underground and remain there until your next turn. During this time, you cannot be the target of any attack. On your next turn, make a melee attack on a creature in range, with advantage, doing 1d10 + MOVE ground damage on a successful hit. If the target has Tremorsense, the attack is not rolled with advantage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Drill Run
moves.description: You crash into an opponent, spinning your body like a drill. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE ground damage on a hit. This attack scores a critical hit on 19s and 20s.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: You cause the ground beneath a grounded opponent to erupt with power. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE ground damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, the target is burned and the next attack against it is rolled at advantage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: You create a tremor in the ground in a 10 foot radius, centered on you. Each grounded creature in the area must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC, or take 3d12 + MOVE ground damage and be knocked prone. On a success, they take half as much damage and are not knocked prone. The area becomes difficult terrain.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d10 at level 5, 6d12 at level 10, and 10d10 at level 17.

moves.name: Fissure
moves.description: You crack open the ground with devastating force. Choose a target in range and roll a d20. On a 20, the target falls into the crack and vanishes into the abyss. On any other roll, or if targeting a flying creature, this move has no effect. The area in a 20 foot radius around the target becomes difficult terrain. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, this move automatically fails.

moves.name: Fossilize
moves.description: You project an ancient light, engulfing creatures in a 15 foot cone. Up to two creatures caught in the light are forced to attempt a CON save, becoming petrified on a failure.
moves.scaling: From level 14, the range of this move is doubled, and VP cost increases to 10.

moves.name: Land's Wrath

effects.note: speed halved

moves.description: You gather in the natural energy of the land around you and focus it into a sudden eruption of earth in a 40ft. radius, centered on a point within range. All grounded creatures caught in the blast must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE ground damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the save have their speed halved until the end of their next turn as the ground clings to them.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Magnitude
moves.description: You shake the ground with an earth-shattering quake. All creature in range must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking half damage on a success and full damage on a fail. Creatures in range that are burrowed or in the invulnerable stage of Dig take double damage from this move. Roll a d100 on the table below to determine damage. 1-5: 1d4+MOVE 6-15: 1d8+MOVE 16-35: 1d10+MOVE 36-65: 1d12+MOVE 66-85: 2d6+MOVE 86-95: 2d8+MOVE 96-100: 2d12+MOVE
moves.scaling:
For damage rolls, use 2x Dice at level 5, 3x
Dice at level 10, and 4x Dice at level 17.

moves.name: Mud Bomb
moves.description: You throw a hard-packed mud ball at a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE ground damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must make a CON save against your Move DC. On a failure, the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll. If activating a move that requires a save, the target(s) have advantage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: You fire a glob of mud at a creature, dealing damage with a chance to hinder the target's movement. Make a ranged attack against a creature in range, dealing 1d6 + MOVE ground damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is higher than 15, the target's speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Mud Sport
moves.description: You cover yourself and all allies around you with thick mud, reducing the amount of electric damage taken for anyone affected. For the duration, you and any ally in range (when you initially activated this move) have resistance to electric-type attacks. If you were already resistant, you are now immune. If you were vulnerable, you now take regular damage. If you are immune to electrictype moves already, nothing happens.

effects.note: each ally in range when cast

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: You hurl mud at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d6 + MOVE ground damage on a hit. On a hit, the target adds -1 to its attack rolls for the rest of the encounter. This decrease may be stacked, up to a maximum of -5 to hit. The target may take an action to remove any mud from its face, resetting the effect.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

effects.note: the target can also remove this by spending an action -- use the badge's Remove button

moves.name: Precipice Blades
moves.description: You gather in the natural energy of the land around you and manifest all of the power into fearsome blades of stone. Make three ranged attack rolls against any creature(s) in range, dealing 3d10 + MOVE ground damage on each successful hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Quicksand Trap
moves.description: The user creates a 20-foot-radius area of quicksand centered on a point within 60 feet. The area becomes difficult terrain, and any creature that enters the area or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained until the end of its next turn.

moves.name: Rototiller
moves.description: You imbue the ground around you with a mystical layer of natural energy, like tilling fresh soil. For three rounds, grass-type creatures double their STAB bonus when activating a grass-type move within the affected area.

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.description: You kick up a cloud of sand in an attempt to blind a target in range. The target must make a CON save against your Move DC. On a fail, for the remainder of the encounter, they add -1 to all of their attack rolls. This move can be stacked for a maximum of -5 to attack rolls.

moves.name: Sand Lance
moves.description: You slam your reinforced horn through defenses. Make a melee attack dealing 3d10 + MOVE ground damage. This attack ignores resistance to Ground damage. On hit, the target's AC is reduced by 2 until the end of your next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Sand Tomb
moves.description: You attempt to summon a wave of sand that surrounds the target. Force a creature in range to make a STR saving throw against your Move DC, taking 1d10 + MOVE ground damage and becoming restrained on a failure, or half as much without being restrained on a success. If it fails, at the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. While a creature is restrained, you may continue this move, as an action, to deal an automatic 1d10 + MOVE ground damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Shore Up
moves.description: You use the power of the earth around you to help heal your wounds, recovering 2d8 + MOVE hit points. If used during a Sandstorm, your MOVE modifier is doubled.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10, and 4d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.description: You scatter spikes across a 15ft radius area centered on a point within 60ft. The area becomes hazardous terrain for 1 minute. When a creature enters the area or starts its turn there, it takes 1d6 + MOVE ground damage (DEX save for half). A creature can only take this damage once per turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, you aggressively attack. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE ground damage on a hit. If your last attack missed, double the dice roll for damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Thousand Arrows
moves.description: You summon forth a volley of green arrows to pierce creatures in range. All creatures in a 30ft. radius, centered on a point within range, must succeed a DEX save, taking 3d10 + MOVE ground damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. This move ignores any immunities to ground type. Any creature that fails the saving throw falls to the ground and is now grounded until the end of your next turn. Grounded creatures are susceptible to ground-based moves, regardless of their type or ability.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Thousand Waves
moves.description: A wave of green energy courses through the battlefield in a 60 foot cone, centered on you. All creatures caught in the wave must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE ground damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Any creature that fails the saving throw cannot flee or be switched out as long as you remain in battle.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Aurora Beam
moves.description: You create a 40 foot line of freezing ice, 5 feet wide. All creatures caught in the line must succeed a DEX save or take 1d10 + MOVE ice damage. Failing by 5 or more causes a creature to freeze.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Aurora Veil
moves.description: You use the environment to create a shield of ice around your body. Only able to be activated while it is hailing, this move can be used as a bonus action to halve all damage dealt to you for three rounds.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: You send forth a heap of powerful snow to pummel an opponent. Make a ranged attack on a target, dealing 1d10 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. If the target has dealt any damage to you since the end of your last turn, double the damage you deal.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: Icy clouds form overhead and pelt the ground with hail and snow, centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature within a 20 foot radius must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE ice damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Targets that fail the save by 5 or more become frozen.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Chill
moves.description: The air around you becomes freezing cold for 5 rounds.

moves.name: Cold Embrace
moves.description: After landing a melee attack, you may use a bonus action to activate this move. Ice cold tentacles wrap around the creature, attempting to freeze it solid. Make a melee attack roll, freezing the creature on a success. On a critical hit, this move is one hit KO.

moves.name: Freeze Shock
moves.description: When you use this move, you charge up a ball of rock-hard ice. On your next turn’s action, if you keep your concentration, you fire your electrically charged ice at a creature. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 3d8 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 15 or more, the target is paralyzed.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 4d8 at level 5, 5d8 at level 10, and 8d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Freeze-Dry
moves.description: You unleash a freezing cold air that rapidly chills a creature in range. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing 2d8 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is frozen. This move deals super effective damage to water-type creatures, ignoring any resistance from other types they may have.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Frost Breath
moves.description: You blow a gust of freezing cold air in a 15ft cone. Creatures caught in the cone must succeed a DEX save or take 1d10 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. Failing the save by 5 or more causes critical damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Frost Inferno
moves.description: You spend one turn drawing in air, readying your attack. Next turn, you let out a stream of intense icy energy in a line 5 feet wide, creating a blizzard with a radius of 10 feet centered on the first creature hit. All creatures caught in the blizzard must make a CON save against your move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE ice damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If the save is failed by 5 or more, the target is frozen.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Frost Shackles
moves.description: The user creates icy restraints on a target within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

moves.name: Glaciate

effects.note: only if the target's speed is reduced to 0 (-5 ft per hit); it can use an action to warm up first

moves.description: You blow a wind of freezing cold air at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 1d10 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. On a hit, reduce the target's speed by 5 feet. A target reduced to a speed of 0 in this manner becomes frozen. The target may use an action at any time (before becoming frozen) to warm its body, resetting its speed.
moves.scaling:
The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.
After level 10, speed is reduced by 10 feet on a hit.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: You stir up a massive hail storm in a 50 foot radius, centered on a point in range. When a non ice-type creature enters the area for the first time on their turn, or begins their turn inside the area, they take an amount of ice damage equal to half your level, rounded up. The hail storm lasts for 5 rounds.

moves.name: Haze
moves.description: You create a haze of light magical snow that washes over all creatures in a 30ft circle, centered on you. Any stat bonuses or modifiers, status effects, shields or other outside forces affecting the stats or abilities of a creature are removed. This includes things like Leech Seed, Focus Energy, Iron Defense, Disable, etc.

moves.name: Ice Ball
moves.description: You summon a rock-hard ball of ice that continues to pummel a creature. When you activate this move, make a ranged attack on a target in range, doing 1d6 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. If you continue to use this move on consecutive turns, double the dice roll for damage each time you hit. The multiplier maxes out at 8x the original damage. For each consecutive use of this move, increase the VP cost by 1. The damage and VP cost reset if any of the attacks fail to damage a creature, if your speed is reduced to 0, or if you are incapacitated.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: You create a 80 foot line of freezing ice, 5 feet wide. All creatures caught in the line must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC or take 2d8 + MOVE ice damage and be frozen on a failure, or half as much without being frozen on a success.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Ice Burn
moves.description: When you use this move, you charge up an intense power within your body. On your next turn’s action, if you keep your concentration, you unleash an ultracold, freezing wind in a 30 foot circle all around you. Anyone caught in the blast must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE ice damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If any creature fails the save by 5 or more, it is burned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: You attempt to pierce a creature with ice infused fangs. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is frozen and flinches.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Ice Hammer
moves.description: You swing and hit with your strong, heavy fist. Make a melee attack dealing 2d8 + MOVE ice damage. Until the end of its next turn, the target has disadvantage on all DEX saves and its speed is halved.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: You strike out with ice-infused fists. Make a melee attack roll, doing 2d8 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is frozen.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description: You flash freeze chunks of ice and quickly hurl them at a creature. As a bonus action, you fire a shard of ice at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 1d6 ice damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Icicle Crash
moves.description: You generate a row of icicles that crash down on top of a creature in range. The target must succeed a DEX saving throw against your move DC, taking 1d10 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target flinches.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Icicle Spear
moves.description: Your pummel a creature in range with multiple sharp shards of ice. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 ice damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: You create an icy wind that gusts towards a creature in range. Make a ranged attack against a creature, doing 1d6 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 18 or more, the target falls prone.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Mist
moves.description: A light mist surrounds a target, offering a protective barrier. The target is immune to negative stat effects or modifier changes for the duration, but any current effects are still in place.

moves.name: Pack Frost
moves.description: All ice type allies within 40ft. may use their reaction to move up to half their movement speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each ally creates a 5ft. wide trail of extreme cold. Any creature that starts its turn inside a trail, or crosses it during, must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d8 + MOVE ice damage and being slowed until the end of their next turn. The trail lasts until the beginning of the user's next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.description: You send a blast of cold snow at a creature. Make a ranged attack roll on a creature, doing 1d6 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or higher, the target is frozen.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.description: You send a chill down the spine of a creature, freezing its core. Choose a target in range and roll a d20. On a 20, the target faints. On any other roll, this move has no effect. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, this move automatically fails.

moves.name: Thermal Shock

effects.note: temperate environments only; speed halved

moves.description: You cause rapid evaporative cooling to happen around a single target in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE ice damage. On a hit, this move triggers different effects based on the temperature of the surrounding environment: - In hot environments: Double the dice for the damage roll. - In temperate environments: Target must succeed a Constitution saving throw or have their speed halved until the end of their next turn. - In cold environments: Creates a 10ft. radius of difficult terrain as moisture instantly freezes.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: 7. Sleep Ray

effects.note: unconscious for the duration; wakes if it takes damage or another creature wakes it; no effect on Steel- and Ghost-types

moves.description: The targeted creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep and remain unconscious for 1 minute. The target awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This ray has no effect on Steel- and Ghost-types.

moves.name: Acupressure
moves.description: You apply pressure to different stress points on your body, boosting a random ability for the duration. When activating this move, roll a d6 and gain the following boost based on the result. When activated on subsequent turns, any previous effect ends. 1: +1 to attack rolls. 2: +2 to damage rolls. 3: +10 temporary HP. 4: +1 to saving throws. 5: Critical Hit range +1 6: +1 to Armor Class

moves.name: After You
moves.description: As a bonus action, choose an ally or opponent in range that has not yet taken its turn in the current round. The target must immediately take its turn now, and return to normal initiative order in the next round.

moves.name: Assist
moves.description: You call upon the help of another active Pokémon in your party. When activating this Move, another player may immediately take an action in place of your own, if you have not already taken an action this turn.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: As a reaction, when dealt damage by an attack, you may force the attacker to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, the creature must roll the damage again and use the lower result.

moves.name: Barrage
moves.description: Make a ranged attack on a Pokémon, rolling 1d4 on a hit. You attack with a barrage of ranged strikes equal to the number shown. Each projectile deals 1d4 + MOVE normal damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: As a bonus action, you may switch a Pokémon out with another Pokémon, passing along all negative status effects or stat changes to the new Pokémon. This includes existing substitutes, critical hit bonuses, AC increases, etc.

moves.name: Belly Drum
moves.description: You sacrifice health for attack. When using this move, take damage equal to half your maximum, but increase your Strength score by 10 while you remain in battle. After activating this move, you are not affected by potions for the remainder of the encounter.

moves.name: Bestow
moves.description: As a bonus action, you may pass your held item to a willing creature in range, if the target is not currently holding an item.

moves.name: Bide
moves.description: You embrace the damage done to you, waiting for your time to strike. Use your attack action to activate this move, and keep track of all damage done to you before your next turn. On your next turn, you lash out at an enemy with a normal ranged attack, striking them for double the amount of damage you took on a successful hit. At 10th Level, you can choose to hold Bide for a second turn for the chance to add additional damage to the attack.
moves.scaling:
You may continue to stockpile damage for 2
turns at level 10 and above.

moves.name: Bind
moves.description: You attempt to grapple a target into submission. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 + MOVE normal damage and is grappled and restrained. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. While a Pokémon is grappled, you may continue this move, as a bonus action, to do an automatic 1d4 normal damage without having to make an attack roll.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Blinding Flash
moves.description: The user emits an intense burst of light. All creatures within a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

moves.name: Block
moves.description: If an opponent within range attempts to flee or switch out, you may use your reaction to stop it dead in its tracks, keeping this from happening.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: You thrust yourself towards an opponent in an attempt to crush them with your physical size. Make a melee attack on a target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 + MOVE normal damage, and must succeed on a STR saving throw against your Move DC or be knocked prone.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Boomburst
moves.description: You generate a powerful shock wave. Any opponent caught in a 40 foot radius, centered on you, must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE normal damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails the save by more than 5, it becomes deafened for 1 minute.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Camouflage
moves.description: You blend in with your surroundings, taking on a new type for resistances/vulnerabilities/immunities. The type is dependent on the terrain, and up to the DMs discretion. (Ex: Forest = Grass, Beach = Water, Desert = Ground/Fire, Mountain = Rock, etc.)

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: You attempt to charm an opponent into pulling its punches. When hit by an attack from an opponent, you may use a reaction to force it to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a failure, the attack does not hit.

moves.name: Celebrate
moves.description: On a successful takedown of an opponent by an ally within 5ft. of you, you may use one reaction to cheer on your ally. Both of you gain advantage on your next attack roll.

moves.name: Chip Away
moves.description: You wait for an opening, striking with speed when the moment is right. Ignoring any boosts to the AC of a target, make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Comet Punch
moves.description: You strike out with a lightning fast punch. Make a melee attack roll. The target takes 1d4 + MOVE on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 normal damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Confide
moves.description: You whisper an untold secret into the mind of an opponent in range. The target must make a WIS save against your Move DC, becoming confused on a failure.

moves.name: Constrict
moves.description: You wrap yourself around an enemy Pokémon, trying to squeeze the life from them. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 + MOVE normal damage and is grappled and restrained. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. As long as the target is restrained on your subsequent turns, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 1d10 normal damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Conversion
moves.description: Your Pokémon takes on a new type for resistances/vulnerabilities/immunities, equal to one of the types of a move it currently knows for the duration.

moves.name: Conversion 2
moves.description: After taking damage from an attack, You may use your reaction to change your Pokémon type to one of your choice that is resistant or immune to the type of move used against you for the duration.

moves.name: Copycat
moves.description: You mimic a target that acted just before you. When activating this move, you use the identical move of the creature whose turn came immediately before yours.

moves.name: Covet
moves.description: You strike out with quick and sticky hands. Make a melee attack roll against an opponent, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. On a successful attack, you steal the opponents held item if you are not currently holding one.
moves.scaling:
The damage dice roll for this move changes to
2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Crush Claw

effects.note: your next attack on the same target

moves.description: You strike out with powerful claws. Make a melee attack roll against an opponent, doing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 15 or more, your next attack on the same target gets an additional +1 to hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Crush Grip
moves.description: You clasp your hands around an opponent for a crushing blow. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing 2d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If the target is above 50% of its maximum health, add your proficiency bonus to the damage roll.
moves.scaling:
The damage dice roll for this move changes to
3d8 at level 5, 4d10 at level 10, and 7d8 at level 17.

effects.note: Target above 50% HP -- add your proficiency bonus

moves.name: Cut
moves.description: You lash out at an enemy with vine or claw or blade. Make a melee roll on an enemy, doing 1d6 + MOVE on a successful hit. This move scores a critical hit on a natural attack roll of 19 or more.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.description: You curl up into a tight ball, increasing your defensive stance. Until your next turn, you gain + 4 to your AC and have resistance to normal attacks.

moves.name: Disable
moves.description: You attempt to disable a Pokémon, hindering its abilities. Choose a target in range. The target must succeed on a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a fail, choose one of the opponent's known moves, that you know it knows. This move is now disabled.

moves.name: Dizzy Punch

effects.note: from level 17 the threshold is 17 or more

moves.description: You strike out with a devastating punch. Make a melee attack roll on a target, doing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 18 or more, the target becomes confused.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17. At level 17, a natural attack roll of 17 or more confuses the target.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.description: You lash out quickly with two strikes. Make two melee attacks, dealing 1d10 + MOVE on each hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Double Slap
moves.description: You reach out to slap a Pokémon with quick strikes. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 normal damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
moves.scaling:
The damage dice rolls for this move change to
1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: You create a duplicate image of yourself, 5 feet beside you. The image copies every move you make. When an enemy hits you with an attack, roll a d4. On a 3 or 4, the image takes all the damage for you and disappears. Enemies with Truesight bypass the effect of this move.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: You commit a massive attack against an opponent. Make a melee attack against a target, doing 3d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit, but taking a quarter of the total damage (rounded down) in recoil.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 4d8 at level 5, 5d8 at level 10, and 8d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Echoed Voice
moves.description: You release a shout that echoes across the battlefield towards an opponent. Make a ranged attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. Until the beginning of your next turn, if any other creature in range uses this move, they may double their damage dice on a hit. This multiplier can continue to stack to a maximum of 8x the damage dice, resetting if any of the attacks miss.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Echoing Screech
moves.description: The user lets out a piercing screech. Each creature within 30 feet must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 2d6 + MOVE normal damage and is deafened for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half damage and isn't deafened.
moves.scaling: 3d6 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, 5d6 at level 17

moves.name: Egg Bomb
moves.description: You hurl a hard egg at a creature that explodes on impact. Make a ranged attack on a creature, doing 4d4 + MOVE normal damage on a successful hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d12 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 8d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Elemental Surge
moves.description: The user channels elemental energy. Roll a d20 to determine the energy type. The user gains resistance to that damage type for 1 minute and their next damaging move deals an extra 2d6 damage of that type.
moves.scaling: Extra damage: 3d6 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, 5d6 at level 17

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: After being targeted by a move, force a creature to make a WIS save against your Move DC as a reaction. On a fail, the target can only use the move that targeted you for its next turn.
moves.scaling:
The number of turns the creature must use the move increases to 2 turns at level 10 and 3 turns at
level 17.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: When you activate this move, select a creature in range. the target must make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, the target’s current HP reduced to be equal to your own. This move can not be used in the first round of combat.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: When damaged by an attack that would otherwise cause you to faint, you may instead fall to 1HP on the first instance of this reaction. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful.

moves.name: Enter Formation
moves.description: You enter a formation with 5 creatures of large size or smaller, that each are within 5 feet of the next. While in formation, all creatures gain advantage on Strength saves, and AC is increased by 2. To maintain formation, everyone's movement is held until the Formation Leader moves the entire formation, unless an individual wants to break it. This effect will not stack. The formation breaks if a gap is created between individuals.

moves.name: Entraintment
moves.description: You dance with a strange rhythm that causes a creature to mimic you. Choose a target in range and force them to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a failure, choose one of their abilities to replace with one of your own for the duration.

moves.name: Explosion
moves.description: You create a sphere of energy that packs a concentrated and devastating explosion. Choose a target within range and roll a d20. On a 20, the explosion goes off and all creature within 5 feet of that point faint. On any other roll, the explosion fails to go off and this move has no effect. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, this move automatically fails. This move may only be attempted once per long rest.
moves.scaling: At level 10, this move may be attempted twice per long rest, and three times per long rest at level 18.

moves.name: Extreme Speed
moves.description: You rush to attack with incredible speed. As a bonus action, you can immediately move up to 15ft and make a melee attack against a creature in range without taking an attack of opportunity, doing 2d8 normal damage on a hit. After a successful hit you may move up to 15ft without incurring opportunity attacks.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Eye Rays
moves.description: You unleash up to three eye rays. Roll a d6 to determine VP cost, and how many eye ray attacks you can perform. 1-2: One ray 3-4: Two rays 5-6: Three rays The rays are fired at random (reroll duplicates).

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: You strike out at a creature with revenge. Make a melee attack roll against a target, dealing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If you are poisoned, paralyzed, or burned, double the dice for the damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

effects.note: You are poisoned, paralyzed, or burned

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description: This move goes first in the initiative order, and is only usable in the first round you are in a combat. You will need to announce it at the beginning of the round. Make a melee attack on a creature, doing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit, causing the target to flinch.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: False Swipe
moves.description: You swipe at a creature but hold back power slightly. Make a melee attack against a creature, doing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If this attack would normally cause a creature to faint, it is reduced to 1HP instead. On a critical hit, the target becomes dazed, reducing capture DC by 20 until the beginning of your next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Feint
moves.description: When a creature you are targeting declares it will use Protect, Detect, or similar protective move in response, you may use your reaction to activate Feint. Your attack bypasses the protection and resolves normally, and the target gets half the VP for the protection move refunded.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: You flail about with a wild strike that increases in power the more injured you are. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If you are below 50% of your maximum health, double the damage. If you are at 10% or below of your maximum health, triple the damage. The multiplier for this attack occurs before the multiplier for resistances or vulnerabilities.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

effects.note: Below 50% HP
At 10% HP or below

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: You emit an immense flash of light in a 20 foot radius circle, centered on you. Creatures in the area must make a CON save against your Move DC. On a fail, they are blinded until the end of their next turn. Outside of combat, this move can be used to light a dim area.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.description: You sacrifice your action to focus in on the energy inside you. For the duration, increase your critical range by 1 (From 20 to 19+ , from 19+ to 18+, etc.). This move is stackable up to a maximum of +5 to the critical hit range (15+).

moves.name: Follow Me

effects.note: all enemies in range; their attacks must target you

moves.description: You entice all enemies to attack you. All enemies within must succeed a WIS saving throw, or their ranged and melee attacks must target you until the beginning of your next turn.

moves.name: Foresight
moves.description: You grant yourself a brief but incredible sixth sense. On the next ghost-, normal-, or fighting-type move you activate, ignore any immunities of the target creature(s) granted by their Pokémon type. If the target’s secondary type gives it vulnerability or resistance to the attack, it follows the secondary type for that effect.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: You lash out at a creature, venting your frustration at your trainer. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit When you make this attack, add an additional bonus to hit and damage equal to the number of levels you are below zero on the Loyalty Chart.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

effects.note: +1 per level below 0 on the Loyalty Chart -- also add this to your attack roll

moves.name: Fury Attack
moves.description: You reach out and unleash relentless strikes against a creature. Make a melee attack roll, doing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 2d6 normal damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 5d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.description: You reach out and unleash relentless claw attacks against a creature. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 normal damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: You charge at a creature with every ounce of your power. Make a melee attack, dealing 4d12 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. You can't use this move consecutively.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Glare
moves.description: You stare into the depths of a creature’s eyes with intense ferocity. The creature must make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC or become paralyzed. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is unaffected by future attempts during this combat.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: You target a creature with an intimidating growl. The creature must make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, it adds -1 to any attack it makes for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple growl saves, up to a maximum of -5.

moves.name: Growth
moves.description: You increase the size of a target. When you use this move, a creature in range (or you) grows slightly larger, gaining the ability to add a d4 to any attack roll or saving throw for the duration.
moves.scaling: The dice to add increases to 1d6 at level 10.

effects.note: OR one ally in range, instead of yourself

moves.name: Guillotine
moves.description: You are filled with an incredible rage, grabbing the head of a target creature in an attempt to squeeze the life from it. Roll a d20. On a 20, you instantly cause the creature to faint. On any other roll, this move has no effect. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, this move automatically fails.

moves.name: Happy Hour
moves.description: You celebrate your impending victory with a little jig. Prize money awarded at the end of battle is doubled. Only applies in official league battles.

moves.name: Harden
moves.description: You increase your defense, able to reduce incoming damage. After activating this move, reduce any damage dealt to you by 1d4 + MOVE until the beginning of your next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

moves.name: Head Charge
moves.description: You lower your head and charge at a creature. Make a melee attack. On a hit, you deal 3d8 + MOVE normal damage, taking a quarter of the total damage (rounded down) in typeless recoil.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 4d8 at level 5, 5d8 at level 10, and 8d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.description: You really know how to use your head. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target falls prone.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Heal Bell
moves.description: You ring a bell that chimes beautifully across the battlefield. All active allied creature in a 60ft circle, centered on you, are healed of their negative status effects.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: You can use a bonus action on your turn to choose one ally other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can hear you. That ally can add a d6 to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes within the next 10 minutes, before the result of the roll is called by the DM. An ally being helped can only have one d6 available at a time.
moves.scaling: The helping dice for this move changes to d8 at level 5, d10 at level 10, and d12 at level 17.

effects.note: also usable on an ability check -- no ability-check roll popup in this tool to attach it to

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: You unleash a wave of force of unknown power at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack on a creature, doing 1d10 + MOVE damage of a random type. Roll a d20 to determine which type of damage is dealt. 1: Normal 2: Fire 3: Water 4: Electric 5: Grass 6: Ice 7: Fighting 8: Poison 9: Ground 10: Flying 11: Psychic 12: Bug 13: Rock 14: Ghost 15: Dragon 16: Dark 17: Steel 18: Fairy 19: Cosmic 20: Your choice
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Hold Back
moves.description: You lash out with force, but contain your strike to a glancing blow, leaving a creature conscious. Make a melee attack on a target, dealing 1d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. This attack will always leave its target with 1 hp if it would otherwise cause the target to faint.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Hold Hands
moves.description: If you are within melee range of an ally, you grasp its hand to spread happiness. Use this reaction when an ally is attacking to add +1 to its attack rolls, or when it is targeted by an attack to add +1 to its AC. This reaction can be used only before the result of either attack roll (by ally or creature) is called.

moves.name: Horn Attack

effects.note: only if you moved at least 20 ft towards the target this turn

moves.description: You strike at a target with your horn. Make a melee attack, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If you moved 20 feet or more towards a target on this turn, force a creature to make a STR save against your Move DC or be knocked prone.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Horn Drill
moves.description: You attempt to drill your horn through a target creature with tremendous strength. Roll a d20. On a 20, the creature is impaled and immediately faints. On any other roll, you miss and this move fails. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, this move automatically fails.

moves.name: Howl
moves.description: You increase your adrenaline with a menacing howl. For the duration, add +1 to any attack roll you make. This move can be stacked for a maximum of +5.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: You unleash a concentrated beam of pure energy in a 80 foot line, 5ft wide. Any creature caught in the line must succeed on a DEX save or take 4d12 + MOVE normal damage and fall prone on a fail, or half as much without falling prone on a save. The damage from this move ignores resistance, but not immunity.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Hyper Fang
moves.description: You lash out at a creature with a quick fang attack. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. Hyper Fang scores a critical hit on 19 and 20. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target flinches.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
