moves.description: You release a loud and startling sound that discourages and intimidates your enemies. All enemies within range must succeed a WIS save, suffering 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a failure, half as much on a success.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Imperial Guard
moves.description: You set your mind to protect your allies and strike back against your enemies. A dark purple aura surrounds you. For the duration, every time you take a hit for an ally that deals damage to you, add 1d6 bonus typeless damage to your next attack. This effect can stack up to five times.

moves.name: Laser Focus
moves.description: When activating this move, you spend your action concentrating intensely. If you keep your concentration, your first attack on your next turn always results in a critical hit.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.description: You lash out an a creature with a furious strike. This move can only be activated when four other known moves by a user have been activated in the same combat, and the user has less than half of its maximum HP or VP left. If the user is switched out, this rule resets. Make a melee attack, dealing 3d12 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d10 at level 5, 6d12 at level 10, and 10d10 at level 17.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: You stare down a target, reducing its will. The creature must make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, allies may add +1 to any attack they target it with for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple leer saves, up to a maximum of +5.

effects.note: "allies add +1 to hit it" -- represented as the target's own AC dropping

moves.name: Lock-On
moves.description: You hone in on your target, ready to strike. When this move is activated, a single attack roll you make next turn is guaranteed to hit. You may roll to see if you crit or cause an effect from a high roll. This move does not affect one-shot moves like Fissure, Guillotine, etc.

moves.name: Lovely Kiss
moves.description: You blow a kiss to a creature, attempting to put the target to sleep. The target must make a CHA save against your Move DC, falling asleep on a failure.

moves.name: Lucky Chant
moves.description: When a creature scores a critical hit on you, you may use your reaction to quickly recite a magical incantation that treats the attack like a normal hit, preventing the extra damage.

moves.name: Me First
moves.description: When targeted by a move that isn't Fake Out or Sucker Punch, you may use your reaction to copy the target's move against it before it makes the attack. If the attack requires a roll, you have disadvantage. On a hit, double the damage dice for the move. The damage/effect tier for the move is based off of your level, not the target's.

moves.name: Mean Look
moves.description: You flash an intimidating look at a target, attempting to freeze them in fear. Force a target in range to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, the target cannot flee or be switched out for 3 rounds.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.description: You strike out with a very hard kick. Make a melee attack against a target, doing 3d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.description: You strike out with a hard punch Make a melee attack against a target, doing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.description: You summon a move at random to inflict against a creature. When you use this move, roll a d100. The resulting number is the TM number for the move you make. If the move is unable to be completed because of positioning, range, etc., Metronome fails.

moves.name: Milk Drink
moves.description: You create a tasty drink that heals your or an ally’s wounds. The recipient gains 2d6 + MOVE hit points.
moves.scaling:
The dice roll for this move changes to 3d6 at
level 5, 5d6 at level 10, and 8d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.description: You copy another creature's movements, learning its ways in battle. When used, this move is temporarily replaced by your choice of one of the target's moves. The target can be an ally. The user can select any of the target's moves to copy for the duration.

moves.name: Mind Reader
moves.description: You sense the motives and moves of a creature around you. When this move is activated, a single attack roll you make next turn is guaranteed to hit. You may roll to see if you crit or cause an effect from a high roll. This move does not affect one-shot moves like Fissure, Guillotine, etc.

moves.name: Minimize
moves.description: You appear smaller, increasing your evasion. For the duration, you gain an additional +2 to your AC.

moves.name: Mop Strike
moves.description: You whip a target with your tail, covering them in slippery suds. Make a melee attack roll, dealing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. The target must then succeed a DEX saving throw, or become slippery, having disadvantage on its next attack.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Morning Sun
moves.description: A ray of sunlight shines upon you, basking you in healing light. The user gains 2d6 + MOVE hit points.
moves.scaling: The healing dice roll for this move changes to 3d6 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 5d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Multi-Attack
moves.description: You strike out with inner power, depending on your primary type. Make a melee attack on a target, dealing 2d8 + MOVE damage of your current primary type.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: You draw in power from your held berry, releasing it into a ranged attack. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE damage on a hit. The type is dependant on what berry you are holding, according to the chart below: Normal - Chilan Fire - Cherri, Occa Water - Chesto, Passho Electric - Pecha, Wacan Grass - Rawst, Rindo Ice - Aspear, Yache Fighting - Leppa, Chople Poison - Oran, Kebia Ground - Persim, Shucca Flying - Lum, Coba Psychic - Sitrus, Payapa Bug - Tanga Rock - Charti Ghost - Kasib Dragon - Haban Dark - Colbur Steel - Babiri, Razz Fairy - Roseli
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Nature Power
moves.description: You call upon the powers of nature nearby and activate a move based on the terrain. The DM gets final say on what move you activate, but here are example terrain types: Cities/Roads/Buildings: Swift Sandy areas: Earthquake Volcanoes/Lava areas: Fire Blast Caves, Dark areas: Shadow Ball Rocky terrain, Mountains: Rock Slide Fields, Plains: Stun Spore Forests, Tall Grasslands: Razor Leaf Ponds/Swamps: Bubble Beam At sea: Surf Underwater: Hydro Pump

moves.name: Noble Roar
moves.description: You let out a stunning roar that intimidates a target. When targeted by an attack, use this reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll

moves.name: Odor Sleuth
moves.description: When you activate this move, choose a target in range. For the duration, the target cannot activate any move that would increase its AC. If it has already activated such a move, the effect ends immediately. In addition, for the duration, no creature in range has immunity to your Ghost, Normal, or Fighting-type moves.

moves.name: Page Slice
moves.description: You slice at your opponent with blades made of sharp paper. Make two attack rolls, dealing 1d4 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. This move ignores resistances and weaknesses, but not immunity. You may use this move as a bonus action.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d12 at level 10, and 1d20 at level 17.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: You split pain from your injuries with your attacker. Target a creature in range, forcing them to make a CON save against your Move DC. On a fail, both you and your attacker change your current health points to the average of the two. If this causes either creature to go above maximum health, they take their maximum health instead.

moves.name: Pay Day
moves.description: You strike a target, causing it to shake out its purse. Make a melee attack, doing 1d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. In addition, 10x the user’s level in cash is scattered on the floor until the end of combat. This release of funds can only occur once per target per combat.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Perish Song

effects.note: includes the user; faints in 3 rounds, on its turn, unless it flees or is switched out first

moves.description: You perform a song with devastating consequences to creatures that hear it. All creatures in range (including you) must make a CON saving throw against your Move DC. For any that fail, they faint in 3 rounds, on their turn, unless fleeing or switched out by their trainer before the end of the three rounds.

moves.name: Play Nice
moves.description: You convince a creature that you mean it no harm. Force a creature to make a CHA saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, any attack the target makes on its next turn is rolled at disadvantage. If the target activates a move that requires a saving throw, you have advantage on the roll.

moves.name: Pound
moves.description: You crush a creature with a pound attack. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing 1d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Present
moves.description: You send a booby-trapped gift to a creature. Make a ranged attack on a creature in range. On a hit, the present explodes, doing 1d6 + MOVE normal damage. If the natural attack roll is 2 or lower, however, regardless if it hits, the present provides the target with 1d6 + MOVE hit points instead.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d4 at level 5, 1d12 at level 10, and 4d4 at level 17.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: You sense incoming danger and are able to quickly avoid it. When targeted by a move (before the attack roll), or forced to make a saving throw, you may automatically avoid the damage/effects on the first instance of this reaction. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful. Unless the successful roll is 20, the damage you take instead drains your VP for half the damage amount.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: You sync up with a creature, copying any positive or negative stat changes affecting them due to weather or moves this combat.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: You lash out with a quick unarmed strike at a creature in range. As a bonus action, you can immediately move up to 10ft and make a melee attack against a creature in range without taking an attack of opportunity, doing 1d6 normal damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Rage
moves.description: You go into a fit of rage, attacking with relentless fury. While you are raging, you gain +1 on all damage rolls (only once per move), have resistance to normal damage, and have advantage on all Strength checks. Your rage ends if you are incapacitated or if you have not attacked a hostile target since your last turn, or taken any damage since then.
moves.scaling: For damage when raging, the bonus changes to +2 at level 5, +4 at level 10, and +6 at level 17.

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.description: You strike out with an incredibly fast spinning move. All creatures within melee range must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. In addition, this move automatically frees the user from Leech Seed or anything causing it to be grappled or restrained. It is removed from these statuses before the saving throw is made.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Razor Wind
moves.description: When you use this move, strong winds begin to circle around you, granting +2 to AC. On your next turn, if you keep your concentration, you release those winds as an action in a 20 foot radius, centered on you. Each creature in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 2d6 + MOVE normal damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Recompose
moves.description: You retreat from the fray to regain your composure. Gain 2d4 + MOVE VP. This move can only be used in combat, when no enemies are within melee range, and can only be used once per long rest.
moves.scaling: The VP gained for this move changes to 4d6 at level 5, 6d8 at level 10, and 8d10 at level 17.

moves.name: Recycle
moves.description: You summon a previously discarded item back into your hands. If you used a consumable held item any time within the last 5 turns, you can activate this move to take advantage of the same effect one last time. This move may not be used in the same round the held item was used.

moves.name: Reflect Type
moves.description: Your body flashes into a mirror for just a moment. When it returns to normal, you take on the type of a creature in range.

moves.name: Refresh
moves.description: A wave of healing energy washes over you, curing poison, paralysis, and burn.

moves.name: Retaliate
moves.description: You rush to avenge a fallen ally. When a creature causes an ally to faint, you may move up to your speed to immediately rush forward and make a melee attack roll on the target, dealing 3d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: You lash out at a creature, in hopes it will please your trainer. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing 1d10 + MOVE on a hit. When you make this attack, add an additional bonus to hit and damage equal to the number of levels you are above zero on the Loyalty Chart.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

effects.note: +1 per level above 0 on the Loyalty Chart -- also add this to your attack roll

moves.name: Roar
moves.description: You release an intimidating roar at all creatures within 15 feet of you. Creatures affected that are not your ally must make a CHA save against your Move DC. On a fail, the creature must immediately Disengage as a free action and move up to its speed in a straight line away from the user, or until met by an impeding force. Moving out of an opponent's melee range will trigger an Attack of Opportunity.
moves.scaling: The effective range for this move increases to 30 feet at level 10.

moves.name: Rock Climb
moves.description: You charge at a target with an attack that attempts to confuse. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 17 or higher, the target becomes confused.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10, and 4d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: You attack a creature's mind with a harsh song. Select a target in range and force them to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a failure, the target takes 1d10 + MOVE normal damage. If an ally in range also knows this move, they can join in the song as a reaction to add an additional damage dice.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10, and 4d10 at level 17.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: You boost defenses for you and all allies in range. For the duration, any ally within range is protected from new negative status conditions oof the following types: asleep, burned, confused, frozen, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned or slowed.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: You put on your scariest face, attempting to paralyze a creature with fear. Force a target in range to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, the target is paralyzed.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.description: You slash out at a creature in range. Make a melee attack, doing 1d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: You let out a horrible screech at creatures in a 20 foot radius, centered on you, distracting them and opening up their defenses. The creatures must make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, allies add +1 to any attack they target an affected creature with for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if a creature fails multiple screech saves, up to a maximum of +5.

effects.note: "allies add +1 to hit it" -- represented as the target's own AC dropping

moves.name: Scrub Down
moves.description: You carefully clean away harmful substances from yourself or an ally. Touch one creature to remove one condition affecting it. The condition is successfully removed if you keep yourr concentration until the beginning of your next turn, and you are still within touching range of the target. This move can be used on yourself.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: You strike a target with unknown power. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 15 or higher, roll a d6 and cause the random effect. 1: Poison 2: Burn 3: Confusion 4: Frozen 5: Paralysis 6: Sleep
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.description: You release a massive explosion in a 30 foot radius, fainting immediately after the attack. Creatures in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC. If your creature has at least half its hit points left, anyone in range takes 4d12 + MOVE normal damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. If your creature has less than half of its hitpoints left, the damage is halved for a failed save, and quartered for a success. After using this move, the creature must succeed death saving throws to survive. It can be stabilized normally, with medicine checks, restoratives or other means, but it will not regain health when given potions. After becoming stable, the creature will have to recover for 1d8 days in order to fullly heal.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Sharpen
moves.description: You collect your focus, sharpening your combat skills. You may add 1d4 to all attack rolls for the duration.
moves.scaling: The dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 10.

moves.name: Shell Smash
moves.description: You break off a piece of your shell, lowering your AC, but improving your attack. When you activate this move, lower your AC by 1, but increase your attack and damage rolls by 1 for the duration. This move cannot stack.

moves.name: Simple Beam
moves.description: You use a mysterious psychic energy to change a target's ability to Simple. Force a target in range to make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, choose one of the target's abilities and change it to Simple for the duration.

moves.name: Sing

effects.note: roll 5d8 + MOVE: that many total hit points of creatures within 30 ft fall asleep, lowest current HP first; a creature is affected only if its HP fits in the remaining total

moves.description: You sing a beautiful song in an attempt to put creatures to sleep. Roll 5d8 + MOVE; the total is how many hit points of creature this move can affect. Creatures within 30 feet of you are affected in ascending order of their current hit points. Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this move falls asleep. Subtract each creature’s hit points from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hit points. A creature’s hit points must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected.
moves.scaling: The number of hit points affected changes to 7d8 at level 5, 6d12 at level 10, and 11d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Sketch
moves.description: When any move is activated within sight of you, use a reaction to copy it to your move list, replacing it with one instance of Sketch in your current move list permanently. Sketch may not be used to copy a Signature or Legendary-only Move.

moves.name: Skull Bash
moves.description: When you use this move, you lower your head and prepare to strike a target within range. On your next turn’s action, if you keep your concentration, you charge at a creature in range, ignoring your walking speed and any opportunity attacks you may incur. Make a melee attack roll, doing 3d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. A creature hit with this attack must succeed on a STR saving throw against your Move DC or be knocked prone.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Slack Off

effects.note: immediately and through your next two turns

moves.description: You give yourself a break, healing your wounds. When you activate this move, you become incapacitated immediately and through your next two turns. Your trainer may not switch you out during this time. At the end of the second turn, regain half of your maximum hit points and become stable once again.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: You crush a creature with a slam attack. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: You slash out at a creature in range. Make a melee attack, doing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. Slash results in a critical hit on 19s and 20s.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: This move can only be used if you are asleep. While asleep, activate a random move from your move list (not Sleep Talk) that has a move time of 1 action.

moves.name: Smelling Salts
moves.description: You procure a handful of strong smelling salt, damaging a creature's senses. Make a ranged attack against a target, dealing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If the target is paralyzed, double the dice roll for the damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

effects.note: Target is paralyzed

moves.name: Smokescreen
moves.description: You conjure a line of smoke on the battlefield, 60 feet long and 5 feet thick, that extends in any direction from a point within range. The area on either side is obscured and imposes disadvantage on any ranged attacks made by a creature targeting another on the opposite side. Any creature inside the wall of smoke, when it is conjured, must make a CON save against your Move DC or become blinded for the duration. A blinded creature can repeat the save at the beginning of its turns to remove the effect on a success.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: While you are asleep, you may activate this move to create a harsh noise that damages all creature within range for 1d8 + MOVE normal damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 4d4 at level 10, and 3d10 at level 17.

moves.name: Soft-Boiled
moves.description: Heal a creature in range for 2d6 + MOVE hitpoints.
moves.scaling: The dice roll for healing changes to 4d6 at level 5, 6d6 at level 10, and 8d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Solvent Spray
moves.description: You spray a cone of powerful cleaning solution. All creatures in a 30-foot cone must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. This move deals double damage to Poison-type Pokémon. All surfaces in the affected area are thoroughly cleaned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

effects.note: Target is Poison-type

moves.name: Sonic Boom
moves.description: You unleash a deafening sound that harms creature in a 20 foot circle, centered on you. Creatures in range must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 20 flat normal damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.

moves.name: Spike Cannon
moves.description: You fire a series of sharp spikes at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 normal damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Spit Up
moves.description: The power of energy stored by Stockpile is released against a target. Make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing a base 1d6 + Move normal damage on a hit. The dice roll is doubled if two rounds of energy were Stockpiled. The dice roll is tripled if three rounds of energy were Stockpiled.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Splash
moves.description: You flail around on the ground, doing no damage and looking ridiculous, but you can leap up to 50 feet in the air.

moves.name: Spotlight
moves.description: You shine a bright light on a creature in range that follows them around the battlefield. The target must make a DEX save against your Move DC. On a fail, attacks against that creature have advantage for the duration.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.description: You use your action to store energy for a Spit Up or Swallow move, increasing your defense. Gain one point of Stockpile. Raise your AC by 1 until you use one of those two moves. This move may be stacked a maximum of 3 times before the energy is used. As long as you have a point of Stockpile, your speed is halved, and you may only use the moves Stockpile, Spit Up or Swallow unless you drop the Stockpile points.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.description: You raise your feet up for a stomp attack. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target flinches.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: You strike out at a creature with brute strength. Make a melee attack roll, doing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. On a hit, you may also choose to push the creature 5 feet away.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Struggle
moves.description: This move is known by all Pokémon, and can be used at any time. You lash out with an unarmed strike, or use an improvised weapon up close or at range to damage a creature. Make a melee or ranged attack roll, doing damage equal to 2 + MOVE typeless damage on a hit.

moves.name: Study
moves.description: You study a target within 50 feet. For one minute, you have advantage on any ability checks or attack rolls against that target.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: You create a duplicate of yourself that copies a quarter of your current HP (rounded down). This substitute moves with you, has an AC of 1 and takes all damage and status ailments you would normally take until it is destroyed. The substiture cannot be healed, and it does not take self-inflicted statuses. If the damage done is enough to destroy the substitute, you take the remaining damage. In future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the move to be successful.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.description: You lash out with an incredible fang attack. Make a melee attack, doing 1d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. This move ignores resistance, but not immunity. On critical hits, instead of rolling for damage, you may choose to do damage equal to half the target’s current HP. Once per long rest, before making the attack roll, you may declare this attack will deal damage equal to half the target's current HP on a hit instead of rolling damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.description: You emit a high pitched screech heard only by the target. Choose a target in range. The target must pass a WIS saving throw against your Move DC or become confused.

moves.name: Swagger

effects.note: the target adds +2 to its attack rolls while confused

moves.description: Force a target in range to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, the target is confused, but it adds +2 to its attack rolls while confused.

moves.name: Swallow
moves.description: You absorb your Stockpiled energy to heal your wounds. When activated after using Stockpile, regain a base 1d6 + Move hit points. The dice roll is doubled if two rounds of energy were Stockpiled. The dice roll is tripled if three rounds of energy were Stockpiled.
moves.scaling: The base healing dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.description: You release a sweet smell directed at a target in range. The target must make a CHA save against your Move DC. On a fail, you have advantage on your next two attacks against that target.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: You fire two projectiles at any creature you choose in range. They do not have to target the same creature. Each hit for 1d8 normal damage. This move also targets creature during the invulnerable stages of Dig, Fly, Bounce, etc.
moves.scaling: You fire 4 projectiles at level 5, 5 projectiles at level 10, and 6 projectiles at level 17.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: When you activate this move, a sword appears and dances around you, increasing your AC by 1. As a bonus action on a future turn, you may drop concentration to release this sword and roll a ranged attack at a target within 30 feet of you, dealing 2d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: You create 3 swords at level 10 and 4 swords at level 17.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: You rush forward and slam into a creature. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing 1d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Tail Slap
moves.description: You strike out against a creature with a quickhitting, hard tail. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 normal damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.description: You shake your tail at a target, distracting it and opening up its defenses. The creature must make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, allies add +1 to any attack they target it with for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple tail whip saves, up to a maximum of +5.

effects.note: "allies add +1 to hit it" -- represented as the target's own AC dropping

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: You sacrifice your own position to take down a creature. Roll a melee attack roll. On a hit, you deal 2d8 + MOVE normal damage, taking a quarter of the total damage (rounded down) in typeless recoil.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Tearful Look
moves.description: You fill your eyes with tears to make all creatures in range lose their combative spirit. All creatures in range must make a CHA save against your Move DC. On a fail, they add -1 to any attack they makes for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if an affected creature fails multiple Tearful Look saves, up to a maximum of -5.

moves.name: Techno Blast
moves.description: You fire a powerful beam of pure light. The line is 80 feet long and 5 feet wide, and all creatues caught in the blast must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The damage type is dependant on the Drive the user holds. (Burn Drive - Fire, Chill Drive - Ice, Douse Drive - Water, Shock Drive - Electric)
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.description: You start to perform a difficult dance, confusing all creatures in range. Creatures in a 20 foot circle around you must make a WIS save against your Move DC, becoming confused on a fail.

moves.name: Testudo Formation
moves.description: While leading a formation, you command your forces to brace for an incoming attack. All creatures that are part of your formation may automatically avoid any damage from the attack this move is a reaction to, and then take half damage from all other attacks until the beginning of your next turn. However, the damage they deal is also halved, and they are rooted together with you until the beginning of your next turn.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.description: You thrash about wildly, doing several attacks without control. Make a melee attack roll, doing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 2d8 normal damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of two additional hits. At the end of this attack, you become confused.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Tickle
moves.description: You turn your melee attack into a playful tickle. As a bonus action at the end of a turn in which you used a melee attack, force a creature to make a CON saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, the target flinches.

moves.name: Transform
moves.description: You attempt to morph into a near-exact copy of a creature in range. For the duration, you copy the target's type, ability scores, skills, speeds, senses, abilities, and current moves. You retain your own feats, level, and HP (Changed CON does not impact your HP).

moves.name: Tri Attack

effects.note: a roll of 4 is rerolled
a roll of 4 is rerolled
a roll of 4 is rerolled

moves.description: You strike with a simultaneous three-beam attack. Each creature in a 30 foot cone, centered on you, must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a fail, and half as much on a success. Targets that fail the save by 5 or more must roll a d4, gaining the status condition as follows: 1. The target becomes burned. 2. The target becomes frozen. 3. The target becomes paralyzed. 4. Must reroll until any number other than 4 appears.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Trump Card
moves.description: You strike out with a blast of energy that increases in strength the more energy has been spent. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. Increase the damage by your Move modifier for every 10VP that has been expended from the total, before the move was activated, up to a maximum of +10.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

effects.note: +MOVE mod per 10VP spent this battle, capped at +10

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: You cause an uproar on the battlefield in a 30 foot circle, centered on you, for three rounds of combat. During the uproar, you cannot use any other Move, and any creature in range wakes and is prevented from falling asleep. (This include creatures that would purposefully fall asleep using moves like Rest) In addition, creatures must make a CON save against your Move DC at the start of each turn. On a fail, the target takes 2d8 + MOVE normal damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Vice Grip
moves.description: You crush a creature with a forceful, gripping attack. Make a melee attack, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit, grappling the target. On each successive turn, if the creature is still grappled, you may use this move again (as an action) and automatically hit. A creature may attempt to excape the grapple at the beginning of its turns with a STR save against your Move DC.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: You send a powerful ball of energy that changes type based on the surrounding weather, dealing 1d10 + MOVE damage of that type. Harsh Sunlight: Fire Rain: Water Sandstorm: Rock Hail or Snow: Ice Foggy: Fairy Cloudy: Normal
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.description: You create a whirlwind of spinning air around you, increasing your AC by +2 until the beginning of your next turn. When you activate this move, any creature within 5 feet of you must succeed on a STR saving throw against your Move DC or fall prone. In wild creature battles, this move can be activated to automatically count as a single success in a group DEX check to run away.

moves.name: Wide Slash
moves.description: You make a sweeping slash attack, hitting up to three targets within reach. Make a single attack roll for all targets, dealing 3d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. Each creature hit must also succeed a Strength saving throw, or fall prone.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Wish
moves.description: You send forth a healing wish that takes time to come true. At the end of your next turn, as a free action, heal a target in range for 3d8 + MOVE hit points.
moves.scaling: The healing dice roll for this move changes to 5d6 at level 5, 4d12 at level 10, and 8d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Work Up
moves.description: You get your adrenaline pumping and go into a frenzy. While worked up, you add +2 to all attack rolls. Your worked up status ends if you are incapacitated or if you have not attacked a hostile target since your last turn, or taken any damage since then.

moves.name: Wrap
moves.description: You attempt to grapple a target into submission. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 + MOVE normal damage and is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. As long as the target is grappled on your subsequent turns, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 1d4 normal damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Wring Out
moves.description: You wrap your hands around the target and squeeze hard. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing 3d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If the target has 50% or more of its maximum HP, double your move modifier for the damage roll.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 5d6 at level 5, 4d12 at level 10, and 8d8 at level 17.

effects.note: Target at 50% HP or more -- double your move modifier

moves.name: Yawn

effects.note: falls asleep at the end of its next turn if it is still in the battle

moves.description: You release a big yawn that causes a creature to become very drowsy. Choose a target in range. If that target is still in the battle at the end of its next turn, it falls asleep.

moves.name: 4. Slowing Ray

effects.note: speed halved; cannot take reactions; one action or bonus action per turn, not both

moves.description: The targeted creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

moves.name: Acid
moves.description: You create a stream of hot acid in a 30 foot cone, centered on you. Creatures caught in the cone must succeed on a DEX save, taking 3d10 + MOVE poison damage on a fail, and half as much on a success. This move bypasses Steel types' immunity to Poison.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Acid Armor
moves.description: You are surrounded by a shield of thick acid for the duration. During this time, your AC increases by 2, and any Pokémon that hits you with a melee attack must succeed on a CON save or take 1d6 poison damage.
moves.scaling:
The damage dice roll for this move changes to
2d6 at level 10.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: You spit a spray of acidic fluid that works to melt away an opponent's defense. Make a ranged attack against a target, dealing 3d10 + MOVE poison damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must make a CON save against your Move DC. On a failure, the target's AC is reduced by 1 until its next long rest. This decrease may be stacked on an opponent, up to a maximum of -3 to its AC. This move bypassses Steel types' Poison imimunity.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Belch
moves.description: You must first have eaten a berry. Make a breath attack in a 15ft. cone, rolling 2d8 of MOVE poison damage on all creatures hit. Hit creatures roll a CON save. On a successful save, they take half damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Clear Smog
moves.description: You throw a clump of special mud that has the power to remove all stat changes from a target. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE poison damage on a hit. On a hit, any stat changes affecting the target since the beginning of battle are reset.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Coil
moves.description: You coil up and concentrate your power. For the duration, gain +1 to your attack rolls, damage rolls, and AC.

moves.name: Corrosive Mist
moves.description: The user exhales a 15-foot cone of corrosive mist. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 3d10 + MOVE poison damage and its AC is reduced by 2 for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half damage and its AC is not reduced. This move bypasses Steel types' immunity to Poison.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Cross Poison
moves.description: You slash at an opponent with a poisonous strike. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE poison damage on a hit. On a poisoned opponent, damage for this move is rolled with advantage..
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

effects.note: Target is poisoned

moves.name: Decomposing Touch
moves.description: You attempt to decompose a target. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing 1d8 poison damage on a hit. If the target is a plant, object, or deceased creature, the decomposition process is accelerated, and will rot completely in 4d4 days unless decomposition is stopped.
moves.scaling:
At level 5, decomposition is completed in 3d4 days.
At level 10, decomposition is completed in 2d4 days.
At level 15, decomposition is completed in 1d4 days.

moves.name: Enzyme Production
moves.description: You spray enzymes at an object to accelerate the decay of organic material. As an action, can weaken an organic object or structure, giving it vulnerability to physical damage for 1 minute.

moves.name: Gastro Acid
moves.description: You hurl stomach acid towards a target. Make a ranged attack. On a hit, the target is covered in the disgusting substance and cannot benefit from the effect of any of its abilities for the duration.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.description: You fire a wad of icky gunk at a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE poison damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or higher, the target is poisoned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Plague Bearer
moves.description: All creatures within 15ft. must succeed a Constitution save or become poisoned.

moves.name: Poison Fang
moves.description: You lash forward with poisonous venom. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE poison damage on a hit, forcing the target to make a CON save against your Move DC. On a failure, the creature is poisoned. A creature poisoned by this move takes double the normal poison damage at the end of each of its turns.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Poison Gas
moves.description: You release a toxic cloud of poisonous gas in a 10 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Any creature that starts their turn in this area must succeed on a CON save against your Move DC, taking 1d6 + MOVE poison damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail this save by 5 or more become poisoned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: You stab a creature with an appendage steeped in poison. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing 2d8 + MOVE poison damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or higher, the target is poisoned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.description: You release a cluster of poisonous spores that burst into the air above a target. The creature must succeed on a CON save against your Move DC, becoming poisoned on a fail.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.description: You strike out at a creature with a poisonous sting. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing 1d4 + MOVE poison damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the creature is poisoned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

moves.name: Poison Tail
moves.description: Poisonous barbs sprout from your tail as you swing it at a creature. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE poison damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is a 19 or 20, the move scores a critical hit and the target is poisoned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Process Waste
moves.description: You release enzymes that clear out impurities in the surrounding area. All creatures in range must succeed a CON saving throw or suffer a status condition. Roll a d4 for each creature to determine status condition: 1: Poisoned 2: Paralyzed 3: Burned 4: Asleep For 1 minute, the area is considered clean and safe from pollution hazards, and Poison type moves deal half damage.

moves.name: Purify
moves.description: You extend a healing energy to remove all status effects from a target. If a status effect is healed, it also restores the user's current hit points by twice its level. This user of this move cannot target itself.

moves.name: Sludge
moves.description: You spew poisonous sludge at a target creature in range. Make a ranged attack, doing 1d10 + MOVE poison damage on a hit. The creature must make a CON save against your Move DC or become poisoned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: You hurl a mass of sticky sludge that may poison creatures in its blast. Make a ranged attack roll against a target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 + MOVE poison damage and the area in a 5 foot radius around it is covered in sludge until the beginning of your next turn. Any creature that enters this area for the first time on their turn, or is in that area at the beginning of their turn must make a CON save against your Move DC or become poisoned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Sludge Wave
moves.description: You send a wave of poisonous sludge at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE poison damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is poisoned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Smog
moves.description: You create a fog of poisonous smog in a 15 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Creatures that begin their turn in the area take 1d4 + MOVE poison damage and must succeed on a CON save against your Move DC or become poisoned. The area of smog is considered difficult terrain, and any attacks made from inside it are done at disadvantage. The smog cloud dissipates at the beginning of your next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

moves.name: Spike Protein

effects.note: a further CON save after the DEX save; loses 4d12 VP at the end of its turn; at 0 VP its HP also drops to 0

moves.description: You eject a cloud of viral particles in a 40ft. cone. All affected creatures must succeed a DEX saving throw or take 10d12 + MOVE poison damage, half damage on a success, and must make on a CON save against your move DC. On a failed CON save, they are infected, and must lose 4d12 VP at the end of their turn. Upon reaching 0 VP, it's HP is also reduced to 0.
moves.scaling:
The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

The status condition VP damage for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 10d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: You send a downpour of potent, poisonous rain in a 5 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Targets in the area must make a CON save against your MOVE DC or become poisoned. Creatures poisoned by this move take double the normal poison damage.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.description: You quickly summon a trap of poisonous spikes around a creature that enters the battle. When a creature is switched into battle, you may use your reaction to force a creature to make a CON save against your Move DC, becoming poisoned on a failure.

moves.name: Toxic Thread

effects.note: while the threads make contact with the target; speed also -10 ft, stackable (the poison itself does not stack)
only if the stacked speed reduction brings its speed to 0

moves.description: You fire a collection of poisonous threads at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll against a target, covering them with threads on a hit. So long as the threads make contact with the target, the target is poisoned and its speed is reduced by 10. This move is stackable to any amount however the poison effect does not affect the target more than once. If this reduction in speed causes their speed to be 0, the target is restrained. The target may use an action to remove the threads from its body, healing the poisoned status.

moves.name: Vaccinate
moves.description: Make a melee attack roll against a creature, injecting it with a medical substance containing virus DNA on a hit, dealing 4d12 + MOVE poison damage, and draining double the damage rolled in VP. Force the creature to make a CON save against your move DC. On a successful save, this move deals half damage, and the creature hit is now immune to all status conditions for 1 minute. On a failure, it is now poisoned, and takes double poison damage at the end of each turn. This move cannot be used consecutively.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Venom Dart
moves.description: After landing an attack for which you had to roll to hit, you may use this move as a bonus action to deal poison damage instead of the move's regular damage. This move always leaves the target poisoned.

moves.name: Venom Drench
moves.description: You drench a creature with an odd, poisonous liquid. Force a creature to make a CON save against your Move DC, becoming poisoned on a failure. If the target is already poisoned, this move automatically hits, causing the creature to now take double the base poison damage at the end of each of its turns.

moves.name: Venomous Embrace
moves.description: The user attempts to grapple a target. On a successful grapple, the target takes 2d8 + MOVE poison damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target is poisoned for 1 minute.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: You attempt to drench a creature in poisonous liquid. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE poison damage on a hit. If the target is already poisoned, double the dice roll for the damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

effects.note: Target is poisoned

moves.name: 6. Telekinetic Ray

effects.note: the beholder also moves it up to 30 ft in any direction

moves.description: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or the beholder moves it up to 30 feet in any direction. It is restrained by the ray's telekinetic grip until the start of the beholder's next turn or until the beholder is incapacitated.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: You hone your abilities and feel a surge of speed course through your veins. Increase your movement speed by 20 feet for the duration. Applicable to any movement type the Pokémon has.

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.description: You use a strange psychic power to teleport yourself and one willing creature in range, switching places on the battlefield.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: Your mind elevates to a new level of focus. Add +2 to you AC and any saving throw you make for the duration, but select one of your moves that is not Amnesia. You forget that move and cannot use it for the duration.

moves.name: Archive Blast
moves.description: You channel the knowledge you have gained from the current battle into a psychic blast. Make a ranged attack against one target, dealing 1d6 + MOVE psychic damage. For every type of move you have witnessed so far during this battle, add 1d6 to the damage dice, for a maximum of 6d6.
moves.scaling: The damage dice used for this move changes to d8 at level 5, d10 at level 10 and d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Barrier
moves.description: You create a transparent shield of psychic energy. While active, the barrier grants +2 to AC for you and any companions within 5 feet of you for the duration.

effects.note: per ally selected within 5ft

moves.name: Calm Emotions
moves.description: You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of creatures. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a Charisma saving throw; a creature can choose to fail this saving throw if it wishes. If a creature fails its saving throw, choose one of the following two effects. You can suppress any effect causing a target to be charmed or frightened. When this spell ends, any suppressed effect resumes, provided that its duration has not expired in the meantime. Alternatively, you can make a target indifferent about creatures of your choice that it is hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target is attacked or harmed by, or if it witnesses any of its friends being harmed. When the effect ends, the creature becomes hostile again, unless the DM rules otherwise.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: You clear your mind of all distractions. For the duration, double your STAB bonus when dealing damage of your type.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: You attempt to enter the mind of an enemy and cause confusion. Make a ranged attack on a Pokémon in range. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + MOVE psychic damage. If the natural attack roll is 15 or more, the target becomes confused.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Control Weather
moves.description: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to use this move. When you use this move, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the GM based on the climate and season. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 × 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.

moves.name: Daylight
moves.description: A 60-foot-radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range. The sphere is bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 60 feet. If you chose a point on an object you are holding or one that isn't being worn or carried, the light shines from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the affected object with an opaque object, such as a bowl or a helm, blocks the light.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.description: You tap into a sleeping Pokémon’s dreams, sucking from its energy pool. Instantly inflict 2d8 + MOVE psychic damage on a sleeping target in range, regaining half as many hitpoints to yourself.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Dream Fang
moves.description: You bite at a creature with psychic energy. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must succeed a WIS saving throw against your move DC, or become drowsy. On a fail of 5 or more, the creature immediately falls asleep.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Dream Mist
moves.description: You reach into the Sea of Dreams to manifest something from the target's subconscious mind. This could be their greatest fear (dealing 10d12 Psychic damage and potentially causing fear), their deepest desire (creating a temporary beneficial illusion), or a memory made tangible (summoning a spectral ally or recreating a lost item for 1 hour). The manifestation lasts for a time, and has appropriate statistics determined by the GM.

moves.name: Dream Rush
moves.description: You send a wave of mental energy, overwhelming a sleeping creature's mind. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 2d8 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit. A creature hit by this move fails to wake up from this and subsequent attacks until the end of its next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Dream Seal

effects.note: cannot be woken by any means; afterwards it sleeps on normally, gains one level of exhaustion on waking and takes 5d4 psychic damage

moves.description: You call upon energy from the Sea of Dreams to trap a sleeping creature. Your target must succeed a Wisdom saving throw against your move DC or be trapped in the condition of sleep for 1 minute without the ability to wake up by any means. After the effect ends, the sleep condition continues like normally. Upon waking up, the creature affected gains one point of exhaustion, and takes 5d4 psychic damage.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: You create an irritating, damaging sound in the mind of a creature. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature in range, doing 1d10 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, the target flinches.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.description: You save an attack to unleash at a later time. When you activate this move, you may choose to attack on this turn, or delay the attack. You may use the attack as a free action at any time during the next three rounds. When you make the attack, make a ranged attack roll, dealing 3d10 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Guard Split
moves.description: You use your psychic power to change your defense to match the target's the best you can. Force a creature in range to make a CHA save against your Move DC. On a failure, for the duration, your AC changes to become an average of your current AC and the target's, rounded down.

moves.name: Guard Swap
moves.description: You use your psychic power to swap defenses with a creature. Force a creature in range to make a CHA save against your Move DC. On a failure, switch armor class with the target for the duration.

moves.name: Heal Block
moves.description: When a creature within range attempts to use an HP recovery move, item, or ability, you may use your reaction to send psychic waves into the mind of the target, preventing the recovery of health. Any items or VP consumed in order to heal are lost.

moves.name: Heal Pulse
moves.description: You emit a healing pulse that restores a target's HP. Choose a target in range (cannot be yourself). The target regains 4d4 + MOVE hit points.
moves.scaling: The healing dice roll for this move changes to 2d12 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 8d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Healing Wish
moves.description: You sacrifice yourself for another one of your trainer's Pokémon. When activating this move, the user faints, but the next conscious creature released by its trainer is healed of all status effects and recovers an amount of HP equal to what the user lost by fainting.

moves.name: Heart Stamp
moves.description: You unleash a vicious blow after acting cute. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Heart Swap
moves.description: Force a creature in range to make a CHA save against your Move DC. On a failure, you employ your psychic power to swap any changes in ability modifiers, AC, attack changes, damage boosts, etc. that are currently in affect on you or the target.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: You attempt to put the target to sleep. The target must make a WIS save against your Move DC, falling asleep on a failure.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.description: You create psychic walls within the mind of a target in range. Force the target to make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, the target is unable to use any Move it knows that is the same as yours for the duration.

moves.name: Instruct
moves.description: You instruct a creature to act again. As an action, choose a target in range. The target must immediately repeat the move they used in their last action or bonus action, without spending the VP.

moves.name: Kinesis
moves.description: You move with incredible speed. Increase your walking, flying, or swimming speed by 20 if it is greater than 0, and add +2 to AC when targeted by ranged attacks for the duration. This move cannot be stacked.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: When you are subject to a ranged attack, use your reaction to take half the damage dealt.

moves.name: Luster Purge
moves.description: You create a blinding bright light that damages creature's eyes and may lower their defense. Creatures in range must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE psychic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. For creatures that fail by 5 or more, they are blinded until the end of your next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Magic Coat
moves.description: A flash of magical energy forms between you and a creature, reflecting negative energy back at an attacker in range. When an attack from a creature causes you to suffer from a negative status condition, they are also affected by the same condition.

moves.name: Magic Room
moves.description: You employ your psychic power to suppress the effect of all held items in a 50 foot circle, centered on you.

moves.name: Meditate
moves.description: You become one with your inner self. For the duration, double your proficiency bonus when it comes to attack rolls and saving throws.

moves.name: Mind Fog
moves.description: The user creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of psychic fog centered on a point within 120 feet. The fog spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature in the fog when it appears must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the creature is stunned for 1 round and has disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks for 1 minute.

moves.name: Miracle Eye
moves.description: You flash your eyes at the target, stunning them briefly and lowering their defenses. When activating this move, choose a target in range and force them to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a failure, any modifiers to their AC are reset, and if they are Dark or Ghost-type, their immunities are relinquished for the duration. If, when losing immunity, the target’s secondary type gives it vulnerability or resistance to an attack of that type, it follows the secondary type for that effect.

moves.name: Mirror Coat
moves.description: When subject to a ranged attack, you can attempt to decrease the damage and send some back at the attacker in range. Using this reaction, the damage is decreased by 1d6 + MOVE. If this causes the damage to fall below zero, the attack is deflected and you may make a ranged attack roll to send it back at the attacker for 1d6 + MOVE psychic damage.
moves.scaling:
The damage dice roll for this move changes
to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Mist Ball

effects.note: any attack it makes before the end of its next turn

moves.description: You fire an explosive ball of damaging mist at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack against a target, doing 4d12 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is higher than 10, the target has disadvantage on any attack it makes before the end of its next turn. This move can't be used consecutively.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

On a failure, they suffer a status condition.
