moves.name: Mystic Stare
moves.description: Your eyes glow purple, staring into the souls of all creatures in range. Make a ranged attack. On a hit, force all creatures in range to attempt a WIS save against your move DC, confusing them on a failure.

moves.name: Photon Geyser
moves.description: A pillar of light erupts from the ground in a 20ft radius, 80ft high cylinder centered on a point in range. Any creature caught in the blast must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE psychic damage on a fails save, or half as much on a success.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Power Split
moves.description: You use your psychic power to change your offense to match the target's the best you can. Force a creature in range to make a CHA save against your Move DC. On a failure, choose either your STR, DEX, or WIS. For the duration, replace the chosen ability score with the average of your current score and the target's score.

moves.name: Power Swap
moves.description: As a bonus action, force a creature in range to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a failure, you employ your psychic power to swap a single ability score with a creature until the end of their next turn, for purposes of attack and damage rolls.

moves.name: Power Trick
moves.description: You employ your psychic power to switch your own attack and defense. Until the end of your next turn, switch your AC with an ability score of your choice (Constitution not included)

moves.name: Prismatic Laser
moves.description: You use the power of a prism to fire a collection of dangerous lasers in a 60 foot line, 5ft wide. All creatures caught in the line must succeed a DEX save or take 3d10d6 + MOVE psychic damage on a fail, and half as much on a save.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: You send a beam of invisible, psychic energy at a target in range. The target must make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC, taking 1d10 + MOVE psychic damage and becoming confused on a fail, and half as much without becoming confused on a save.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: You tap into a target’s mind, damaging their will to fight. Make a ranged attack against a creature in range, doing 2d8 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or higher, damage is rolled with advantage, and the target becomes confused.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Psychic Fangs
moves.description: You materialize a set of large fangs that bite at a creature with psychic energy. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit. On a hit, this move automatically ends a creature’s Light Screen, and bypasses Reflect with no effect.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Psychic Terrain
moves.description: Psychic energy emerges from the ground in a 40ft, centered on you. Begininng at the end of your turn, for three rounds, all grounded creatures in the affected area are unable to use bonus actions. Grounded creatures are those that do not have a flying speed or Levitate, Magnet Rise, or similar ability. In addition, creatures may double their MOVE modifier on damage rolls from psychic-type moves activated inside the area.

moves.name: Psycho Boost
moves.description: You send an extremely powerful wave of psychic energy at creatures in a 60 foot cone. Creatures in the wave must make a WIS save against your Move DC, taking 10d12 + MOVE psychic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The power of the move exhausts you, and your next attack is done at disadvantage. If your next attack requires a saving throw, affected creatures have advantage. This move can only be used once per long rest.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Psycho Current
moves.description: You create a psychic wave that swirls around a creature in range, attempting to restrain it. Make a ranged attack. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 + MOVE psychic damage and is restrained. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. On each successive turn, if the creature is still restrained, you may use this move again (as an action) and automatically hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.description: You tear at a target with blades formed by psychic power. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on natural rolls of 19 or 20.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Psycho Shift
moves.description: You employ your psychic power to transfer a status condition to someone else. Choose a willing ally (or yourself) and a creature in range. Force the target to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a failure, a status affecting the ally (or you) is transferred to the target instead.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: You materialize a psychic wave that shocks a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Psystrike
moves.description: You materialize a psychic wave that shocks a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Psywave
moves.description: You emit a wave of psychic energy in a 40 foot line, 5 feet wide. Each creature caught in the wave must make a WIS save against your Move DC, becoming confused on a fail.

moves.name: Record Keeper
moves.description: You record one ability used by a creature within 30 feet during the last round.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: When you are subject to a melee attack, use your reaction to take half the damage dealt.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: You put yourself to sleep, but recover 4d6 + MOVE hit points in the process.
moves.scaling: The dice roll for healing increases to 6d6 at level 5, 8d6 at level 10, and 8d10 at level 17.

moves.name: Role Play
moves.description: You attempt to copy a creature's abilities for the duration. Select a target in range and force them to make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, replace one of your own current abilities with one of theirs.

moves.name: Royal Guard
moves.description: A glowing barrier of hieroglyphic text surrounds you in a 15 foot radius, protecting you and any creatures within the barrier from damage and status conditions. For the duration, the AC of you and all allied creatures inside the barrier is increased by 2, and you are immune to all incoming status conditions.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: You attempt to swap abilities with a creature for the duration. Select a target in range and force them to make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, choose which abilities to switch for the duration.

moves.name: Speed Swap
moves.description: You use your psychic power to swap speed with a creature. Force a creature in range to make a CHA save against your Move DC. On a failure, switch speed with the target for the duration.

moves.name: Spirit Growth
moves.description: You channel a strong determination from deep within your mind. For the duration, all moves drawing on WIS for move power cost half their normal VP, rounded up.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: You use your psychic energy to attack with stored power. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit. Add an additional damage dice for each bonus applied to any of your attack, damage, or AC stats. (For example, if you or an ally has activated moves that are currently boosting your AC, attack, and damage rolls by +1, add three additional damage dice.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Synchronoise
moves.description: You emit a strange soundwave that only damages creatures that share a type with you. Any creature within a 20ft circle that shares at least one of your types must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE psychic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Telekinesis
moves.description: You use your psychic power to attempt to hold a creature above the ground, making it vulnerable to attacks. Force a creature in range to make a CON save against your Move DC. On a failure, the creature is grappled and restrained for the duration, unable to release itself as long as you hold your concentration. While grappled, the creature is considered Raised.

moves.name: Telepathy
moves.description: You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature with which you are familiar. The creature can be anywhere on the same plane of existence as you. The spell ends if you or the target are no longer on the same plane. Until the effect ends, you and the target can instantaneously share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages with one another through the link, and the target recognizes you as the creature it is communicating with. The spell enables a creature with an Intelligence score of at least 1 to understand the meaning of your words and take in the scope of any sensory messages you send to it.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.description: You disappear from view and reappear at an unoccupied point within range. In wild creature battles, this move can be activated to automatically count as a single success in a group DEX check to run away. You may spend 20VP instead of 5 to use this move as a bonus action instead.

moves.name: Treasure Room
moves.description: You create a portal to a pocket dimension in the ethereal plane that looks like a vault. While the portal is active, it allows creatures and objects to move freely in and out of the vault. The effect can be ended early at will, or when you lose concentration. The vault contains lockers that can store treasure. When the portal closes, any creatures within the vault is ejected.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: You move quickly to attempt to swap held items with a creature. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, swapping held items with them on a hit.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: The world around you seems to spin for a moment, and the whole battlefield is hit with a bizarre feeling. Starting at the beginning of the next round of combat after you activate this move, the initiative order is permanently reversed.

moves.name: Vertigo Blast

effects.note: speed halved

moves.description: The user releases a wave of disorienting psychic energy. Target creature must make a Wisdom saving throw or become incapacitated for 1 round and have its speed halved for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the speed reduction on a success.

moves.name: Wonder Room
moves.description: You create a bizarre vibe in the air in a 50ft circle, centered on you. For the duration, all WIS saves become CON saves and all CON saves become WIS saves.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: You focus all of your willpower into your head and ram it into a creature. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 17 or higher, the target flinches.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: 8. Petrification

effects.note: begins to turn to stone
after the restrained stage: must repeat the save at the end of its next turn

moves.description: The targeted creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified for 1 minute.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: You lash out with unknown inner power. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing 1d10 + MOVE rock damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, all of your ability scores go up by 1 while you remain in battle. This move can be stacked for a maximum of +5 to all ability scores.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Diamond Storm
moves.description: You hurl a cloud of sharp crystals that damages all creatures in range. Creatures within 20 feet of you must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE rock damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Head Smash
moves.description: You lower your head to deliver a dangerous headbutt. Make a melee attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE rock damage on a hit. On a hit, the user takes 1/2 the damage dealt in typeless recoil.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Petrifying Gaze

effects.note: begins to turn to stone
follows the restrained stage

moves.description: The user fixes its gaze on one creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be restrained as it begins to turn to stone. At the end of its next turn, the target must repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified for 1 minute.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: A ray of light bursts out of your gemstone, damaging a creature in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE rock damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.description: You summon a series of rocks that fire their way towards a creature. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE rock damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d4 rock damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d4 at level 5, 1d12 at level 10, and 4d4 at level 17.

moves.name: Rock Polish
moves.description: You polish your body to a fine shine to reduce friction. When activating this move, increase your AC by 2 and your speed by 20 feet for three rounds.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders appear above a target creature in range, crashing down on top of it. The target must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE rock damage and falling prone on a failed save, and half as much without falling prone on a success. Creatures that succeed the save by 5 or more dodge the attack entirely. The target gains advantage on the saving throw if this move is used consecutively.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Rock Throw
moves.description: You hurl a rock at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d6 + MOVE rock damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: You summon a collection of boulders that attempt to surround a target. Force a creature in range to make a STR saving throw against your Move DC, taking 1d10 + MOVE rock damage and becoming restrained on a failure, or half as much without being restrained on a success. If it fails, at the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. While a creature is restrained, you may continue this move, as an action, to deal an automatic 1d10 + MOVE rock damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Rock Wrecker

effects.note: other creatures within 5 ft of the target

moves.description: You summon a huge boulder and launch it at a target in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing 4d12 + MOVE rock damage and be knocked prone on a hit. If this move hits, any creature standing within 5ft. of the target must succeed a DEX saving throw or take half of the damage rolled and be knocked prone. This move saps you of energy, and you may not make any attack until after the end of your next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: You roll into a target, repeatedly making attacks with increasing strength. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing 1d6 + MOVE rock damage on a hit. If you use this move on your turn in consecutive rounds, double the dice on each successful attack for a maximum of 5 attacks, in which case the damage would reset. For each consecutive use of this move, increase the VP cost by 1. The damage and VP cost reset if any of the attacks fail to damage a creature, if your speed is reduced to 0, or if you are incapacitated.
moves.scaling: The damage dice changes to a d8 at level 5, a d10 at level 10, and a d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: You stir up a massive sandstorm in a 50 foot radius, centered on a point in range. When a non rock-, steel-, or ground-type creature enters the area for the first time on their turn, or begins their turn inside the area, they take an amount of rock damage equal to half your level, rounded up. The Sandstorm lasts for 5 rounds.

moves.name: Smack Down

effects.note: also loses any flying speed and ground-type immunity until the end of your next turn

moves.description: You throw a solid piece of stone at a creature in an attempt to bring them to the ground. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE rock damage on a hit. On a hit, the target is knocked prone, losing any flying speed and immunity to ground-type moves until the end of your next turn. If the target was in the air, it falls to the ground, taking 1d6 fall damage per 10 feet fallen, to a maximum of 20d6.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: You prepare jagged rocks to strike creatures that reveal themselves. For 1 minute (concentration), when a creature first becomes visible to you (entering your line of sight, appearing from stealth, being switched in, or emerging from teleportation), you may use your reaction to make a ranged attack against it, dealing 1d6 + MOVE rock damage on a hit. This reaction does not consume your reaction for the round. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per casting.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The earth moves beneath a target’s feet as sharp stone pierce through the ground underneath them. Creatures in a 10 foot radius centered on a point you choose in range must make a DEX save against your MOVE DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE rock damage on a fail, or half as much on a save.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Stone Maw

effects.note: only if the target is smaller than you; it is swallowed
only if the target is smaller than you; it is swallowed

moves.description: You bite down on an opponent in an attempt to swallow it. Make a melee attack against a creature, doing 3d10 + MOVE rock damage on a hit. If the creature is smaller than you, it has to make a DEX save against your move DC. On a failure, you swallow it, and it is considered grappled and restrained. At the start of the swallowed creature's turns, it takes 1d12 rock damage. On its turn, it may attempt to free itself by succeeding a STR contest against your CON, with disadvantage. If you lose half or more of your current HP in a single turn while having swallowed a creature, you must succeed a DC15 CON save, or have to spit out the swallowed creature.
moves.scaling:
The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

The damage done at the start of a swallowed creature's turn becomes 4d6 + your STR modifier after level 10.

moves.name: Wide Guard
moves.description: You have the ability to guard your allies from area-of-effect moves. As a reaction, when a creature activates a damaging move that damages multiple allies within range, you may halve the damage dealt. On future instances of this reaction in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll or forfeit the reaction with no effect.

moves.name: Autotomize
moves.description: You shed away part of your body to make yourself lighter and increase your speed. For the duration, your speed increases by 10 feet. This move may be stacked to a maximum speed increase of 30 feet.

moves.name: Bell Toll
moves.description: You emit a loud chime that can be heard by all creatures in range. Affected creatures will wake up, and can't fall asleep for the duration. While tolling, creatures that begin their turn within 15ft. of you must succeed a CON save at the beginning of their turns, or take 2d8 + MOVE steel damage. Failing the save by 5 or more causes critical damage and deafness for 1 minute.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.description: You strike with a punch that is quick as a bullet. At the beginning of a round of combat, you may announce that you are using this move, immediately jumping to the top of the initiative order for that round only. Make a melee attack on an opponent, dealing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Coin Toss
moves.description: You hurl small metal objects towards a target. Make two ranged attacks, doing 1d4 steel damage on each successful hit. You may pay 25 x the damage rolled to double the damage of a hit from this move once per target per encounter.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 2d6 at level 10, and 3d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Debris Break

effects.note: on the second attack only

moves.description: You clamp down on a target, attempting to crush it. Make an attack roll, dealing 1d12 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a successful hit, the target is considered grappled. If the first attack hit, make another attack roll with advantage, dealing an additional 3d6 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or more on the second attack, the target's AC is reduced by 1 until its next long rest. This effect stacks up to three times.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8  and 3d8 at level 5, 5d4 and 3d10 at level 10, and 4d8 and 3d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Flash Cannon

effects.note: the next attack against the target

moves.description: You gather energy from the light around you and send a concentrated beam towards a creature in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the next attack against the target is rolled at advantage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Formation Strike
moves.description: While leading a formation, you command your forces to attack in unison. Make a melee attack roll against a target, dealing 1d6 + MOVE steel damage for each creature in your formation.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to d8 at level 5, d10 at level 10, and d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Gear Grind
moves.description: You send a pair of steel gears at up to two targets in range. Make two ranged attacks, dealing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage with each hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Gear Up
moves.description: You engage your gears to raise the attack of ally creatures in range with the Plus or Minus ability. While you maintain your concentration, Pokémon under the effects of Gear Up have advantage on all attack rolls.

moves.name: Gold Rush
moves.description: You strike a target, causing coins to scatter everywhere. Make a melee attack, doing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. In addition, 10x the sum of the user’s level + the damage rolled in cash is scattered as gold dust on the floor until the end of combat.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: You tackle a creature with a high-speed spin. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing 1d6 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. If your DEX score is lower than the target's, double the dice roll for damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

effects.note: Your DEX is lower than the target's

moves.name: Heavy Slam
moves.description: You slam into a creature with your heavy body. Make a melee attack on a target, dealing a minimum of 1d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. Add an additional bonus to damage equal to your MOVE modifier for each size level you are above a creature. (Sizes, in order, are: Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge, Gigantic)
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

effects.note: +MOVE mod per size level above the target

moves.name: Industrial Solvent
moves.description: You unleash a powerful industrial cleaning solution in a wide cone. All creatures in a 40-foot cone must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE steel damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. This move deals double damage to Poison-type and Steel-type Pokémon. Steel type creatures and creatures wearing metal armor that fail the save have their AC reduced by 1 for 1 minute (this effect stacks up to -3 AC). The entire area is thoroughly cleaned and sterilized.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: Your body temporarily becomes solid as steel plate. Until your next turn, you gain + 6 to your AC and have resistance to all types of damage. If you were vulnerable, you now take regular damage. If you were already resistant, you become immune.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: You slam into the target with your hard head. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or higher, the target flinches.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Iron Tail

effects.note: for the rest of combat

moves.description: You swing your tail out, attempting to crush a creature. Make an attack roll on a creature in range, doing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is a 19 or 20, the target’s AC is decreased by 1 for the rest of combat.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: King's Shield
moves.description: Your body is cloaked with a protective shield that negates all damage to you. When targeted by an attack, you may automatically avoid taking damage from this attack and any other damaging move until the beginning of your next turn. You may still suffer secondary effects. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful.

moves.name: Magnet Bomb
moves.description: You hurl a steel ball that seeks out a creature in range, never missing. This move is guaranteed to hit for 1d10 + MOVE steel damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Maintenance
moves.description: You perform emergency maintenance on a creature or structure. Touch one target to restore 3d10 + MOVE hit points. If used on a structure or object instead, it is reinforced, gaining +5 AC and resistance to all damage types for 1 hour. This move can be used 3 times per long rest.
moves.scaling: The healing dice roll for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Metal Burst

effects.note: loses HP equal to its proficiency bonus each time it spends VP or uses its movement

moves.description: You lash out in retaliation with a bust of harsh metal shards. As a reaction, when you are hit with a melee attack that deals damage, make a melee attack roll against your attacker, with disadvantage. On a hit, deal the same amount of damage rolled as steel type damage back at your attacker. In the unlikely event of a natural 20, the target will suffer from bleeding wounds for 3 rounds, losing HP equal to its proficiency bonus each time it spends VP or uses its movement during this time.

moves.name: Metal Claw

effects.note: add your proficiency bonus to your next attack

moves.description: You strike out with sharp claws. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing 1d6 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, add your proficiency bonus to your next attack.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.description: You emit an ear-shattering high pitched sound that only your target can hear, leaving them in a defenseless state. When activating this move, a target must make a CON saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, all attack rolls against the target are given a +5 bonus until the end of your next turn.

effects.note: "+5 to attacks against it" -- represented as the target's own AC dropping

moves.name: Meteor Mash

effects.note: your next attack

moves.description: You smash a creature with a fist as fast as a meteor strike. Make a melee attack against a creature, doing 3d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. If the natura attack roll is 18 or higher, your next attack has advantage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Mirror Shot
moves.description: You loose a damaging flash of light from your polished body. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must make a CON save against your Move DC. On a failure, the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Parry
moves.description: When subject to any targeted attack with a STR or DEX move power, you may use your reaction to attempt to parry it. Make a contested roll against your opponent's Strength or Dexterity ability score. On a higher roll, you take no damage from the attack, but may still suffer other effects. On a natural roll of 19 or higher, you succeed, suffer no effects and retain your reaction this round.
moves.scaling: The treshold for retaining your reaction drops to 18 at level 5, 17 at level 10 and 16 at level 17.

effects.note: Only if you already won the contested STR/DEX roll (natural 19-20 always succeeds).

moves.name: Sentinel Strike
moves.description: When a targeted attack would hit an ally adjacent to you, you can choose to take the damage instead. If you do, your next attack against that target has advantage.

moves.name: Shield Dome
moves.description: You emit a strong vibration, creating a dome barrier in a 15ft. radius around you. For the duration, creatures must succeed a Strength check against your move DC in order to pass through the barrier, and ranged attacks can't pass through it. You may allow a creature to pass through, automatically succeeding the saving throw.

moves.name: Shield Guardian
moves.description: You protect a creature next to you from an incoming targeted attack by moving to block it, negating all damage and effects. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful, or suffer the damage and effects yourself.

moves.name: Shift Gear
moves.description: You rotate your gears quickly, raising your attack and speed. When you activate this move, add +1 to your attack and damage rolls, and +10 to your speed for the duration. At the start of each of your turns while active, spend 2 VP or the effect ends.
moves.scaling: The attack and damage roll bonus for this move changes to +2 at level 5, +3 at level 10, and +4 at level 17.

moves.name: Smart Strike
moves.description: You pinpoint the perfect place to strike a creature with a horn as strong as steel. This move is guaranteed to hit for 1d6 + MOVE steel damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Sqeegee Slash
moves.description: You slash with a blade-like cleaning edge. Make a melee attack roll, dealing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on a natural attack roll of 18 or higher. On a critical hit, the target's AC is reduced by 1 until their next long rest, stacking up to -5. This move leaves a perfectly clean streak on any surface struck.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: You strike a target hard with outstretched wings. Make a melee attack on a creature, doing 1d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Sunsteel Strike
moves.description: You slam into the target with the force of a meteor. Make a melee attack, dealing 4d12 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. This move ignores any abilities of the target creature that would decrease its ability to hit or deal full damage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Wealth's Burden
moves.description: You smash into a creature with your metal fist. Make a melee attack against a creature, doing 3d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must succeed a STR saving throw or fall prone. If the natural attack roll is 16 or higher, the target's speed is reduced by half until the end of its next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.description: You lunge at an opponent with incredible speed. At the beginning of a round of combat, you may announce that you are using this move, immediately jumping to the top of the initiative order for that round only. Make a melee attack on an opponent, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Aqua Phase
moves.description: You disappear from view and prepare to surprise a target with an attack. When you activate this move, you become invisible and immune to any attacks of opportunity. You cannot be targeted by attacks while you are invisible. On your next turn, you use may your action to reappear at a point within range and make a melee attack against a creature, with advantage, dealing 4d12 + MOVE water damage on a successful hit. Protect and Detect reactions may not be used when hit by this attack.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.description: You surround yourself with a veil of healing water. At the end of each of your turns, as long as you hold concentration, regain a number of hit points equal to your level.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: You lash out with your tail to strike an opponent. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Astral Jet
moves.description: You lunge at an opponent with incredible speed. At the beginning of a round of combat, you may announce that you are using this move, immediately jumping to the top of the initiative order for that round only. Make a melee attack on an opponent, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a hit. You partially phase out of existence. Protect and Detect reactions may not be used when hit by this attack.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Brine
moves.description: You send a harsh blast of salt water at an opponent. Make a ranged attack against an opponent, dealing 1d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. If the opponent has less than 50% of its max HP, double the damage dealt.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

effects.note: Target below 50% HP

moves.name: Bubble
moves.description: You shoot a series of quickly moving bubbles at a target. Make three ranged attacks, doing 1d4 water damage on each successful hit.
moves.scaling:
The damage dice roll for this move changes to
1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.description: You shoot a concentrated stream of bubbles in an 80 foot line, 5 feet wide. All Pokémon caught in the line must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 1d10 + MOVE water damage on a failed save, and half as much on a success.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Clamp
moves.description: You clamp down on an enemy Pokémon, attempting to deal damage and keep them in place. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + MOVE water damage and is grappled and restrained. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to pry itself away with a STR save against your Move DC. As long as the target is restrained on your subsequent turns, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 1d6 water damage.
moves.scaling:
The damage dice roll for this move changes to
1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Crabhammer
moves.description: You slam down onto an opponent with a heavy claw. Make a melee attack roll on a target, dealing 3d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on rolls of 19 or 20.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17

moves.name: Dive
moves.description: When you activate this move, you dive down and disappear into the Ethereal plane. You may not be targeted by attacks in the Ethereal plane. On your next turn, as an action, you reappear and attempt to strike an opponent from below. Make a melee attack roll on an opponent in range, with advantage, doing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Hydro Cannon
moves.description: You emit a powerful stream of high-speed water at creatures in an 80 foot line, 5 feet wide. All creatures caught in the blast must make a DEX saving throw against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE water damage on a failure, and half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the save also are pushed back 10 feet and fall prone. This move saps you of energy, and you may not make any attack until after the end of your next turn.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: You send a surge of powerful water towards creatures in a 80 foot line, 5 feet wide. All creatures caught in the blast must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE water damage on a failed save, and half as much on a success.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17

moves.name: Ink Veil
moves.description: You surround yourself with a cloud of glowing ink, protecting from any status conditions for the duration. If you a condition is inflicted on you while Ink Veil is active, instead roll 3d10, regenerating that much HP and VP.
moves.scaling: The regeneration dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description: You summon a wave of muddy water in a 30ft. cone. All creatures caught in the wave must make a CON saving throw against your move DC, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a failure, half damage on a success. If an opponent fails the save by 5 or more, it has disadvantage on its next attack.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Oblivion Ink
moves.description: A strange ink emanates from your body, and descends on a creature in range, making them forgetful. Make a ranged attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. For 1d6 turns, the last move used by the creature is disabled.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17

moves.name: Octazooka

effects.note: for the remainder of this combat

moves.description: You send a blast of ink towards your creatures. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target must add -1 to attack rolls for the remainder of this combat.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Origin Pulse
moves.description: Your body glows a bright and brilliant blue, sending three beams of focused light at any creature(s) in range. Make a ranged attack for each beam, dealing 4d12 + MOVE water damage on each successful hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Purge Current
moves.description: You whip up a strong purifying vortex of water energy that clears field hazards and status conditions in the area. All creatures affected must succeed a STR saving throw or take 4d12 + MOVE water damage and be knocked prone. On a successfull save, they take half damage and are not knocked prone. For every hazard removed, and depending on the terrain, add 1d8 bonus damage of appropriate type for each element flung into the vortex (GM discretion). Additionally, all creatures affected that suffer from a status condition must succeed a CON saving throw or lose their status condition, and take double damage. If used underwater, the damage is rolled with advantage.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: You summon a heavy rainfall that covers the battlefield for 5 rounds.

moves.name: Razor Shell
moves.description: You strike a creature with a razor sharp shell. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 18 or higher, lower the creatures AC by 1. This decrease may be stacked, up to a maximum of -5 to AC.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Sapphire Torrent
moves.description: You begin circling in the air at incredible speeds, creating a vortex of energy fed by atmospheric water for one turn. While charging this attack, your AC is temporarily increased by 5. On your next turn, the accumulated water is released all at once in a sparkling sapphire torrent in a 50 foot line. Any creature caught in the line must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE water damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails the save by more than 5, it is paralyzed, and frightened for three turns. During heavy rain, this move does not need charging.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

moves.name: Scald
moves.description: You instantly boil water within you to a damaging temperature, blasting a creature with its heat. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or more, the target is burned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Soak
moves.description: You fire a torrent of water at a creature with such force that it leaves lasting effects. Force a target in range to make a CON save against your Move DC. On a failure, their type changes to water for three rounds.

moves.name: Sparkling Aria
moves.description: You burst into song, unleashing a flurry of bubbles in a 10ft circle, centered on you. All creatures in range must make a DEX save or take 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a fail and half as much on a save. Any creature suffering from the burned condition will be cured upon touching the bubbles.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Steam Eruption
moves.description: You shoot out a cone of intensely hot steam from your body, immersing creatures in range. All creatures in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE water damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a target fails the save by 5 or more, it becomes burned.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: You create a powerful wave that crashes down on creatures in a 30 foot cone. Any creature caught in the blast must make a DEX saving throw, taking 2d8 + MOVE water damage and falling prone on a failure, or half as much without falling prone on a success.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Surface Glide
moves.description: You channel water energy to boost your movement. Gain double speed on and in water. While this effect is active, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity. If it is raining, all surfaces are considered to be water for you.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.description: You fire a quick spurt of water at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d6 + MOVE water damage on a hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Water Pledge
moves.description: You send a column of water towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a hit. After you land a hit, any ally that uses another Pledge move in the same round automatically hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: You send a wave of ultrasonic aquatic energy at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 1d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 17 or higher, the target is confused.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Water Shuriken
moves.description: You fire a barrage of sharp shurikens at a target. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE water damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, another shuriken strikes the target for an additional 1d4 water damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
moves.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

moves.name: Water Sport
moves.description: You soak yourself and all allies with water, reducing the amount of fire damage taken for anyone affected. For the duration, you and any ally in range (when you initially activated this move) have resistance to fire-type attacks. If you were already resistant, you are now immune If you were vulnerable, you now take normal damage. If you are immune to fire-type moves already, nothing happens.

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.description: You fire a blast of water at a creature that increases in power the more healthy you are. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature, doing 4d12 + MOVE water damage on a hit if you are at or above 50% of your health. If you are below 50%, halve the total damage done.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

effects.note: Below 50% HP -- halve the total damage after rolling (not the dice)

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: You create an intense waterfall that crashes down on creatures in a 10 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Creatures in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC or take 2d8 + MOVE water damage and fall prone on a fail, or half as much on a save.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: You create a wave of water that swirls around a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 + MOVE water damage and is restrained. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. On each successive turn, if the creature is still restrained, you may use this move again (as an action) and automatically hit.
moves.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.description: When subject to a melee or ranged attack, you can spend your reaction to increase your AC by +2 if it would cause the attack to miss.
moves.scaling: Increase your AC by +3 at level 10 and above.
